Title: Banking Data Scientist - Advanced Analytics, IA Generativa
Description:
En NTT DATA buscamos una persona con experiencia en Data Science y analítica avanzada para participar en proyectos de transformación para entidades financieras.




Trabajarás en la intersección entre negocio, datos e inteligencia artificial: desde la definición del problema hasta la puesta en producción de soluciones que puedan utilizarse y evolucionar.




Formarás parte de equipos multidisciplinares que desarrollan soluciones de datos para banca, combinando modelización predictiva, procesamiento de grandes volúmenes de información e IA Generativa. Tendrás espacio para aportar criterio técnico, traducir necesidades complejas en casos de uso viables y acompañar a perfiles con menor experiencia.







¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Diseñar y desarrollar modelos predictivos y soluciones de analítica avanzada para casos de uso del sector financiero.
Trabajar con datos a gran escala mediante Python, PySpark y SQL, asegurando calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad.
Construir pipelines de datos y modelado end-to-end, desde la exploración hasta la integración en entornos productivos.
Validar, optimizar y evaluar modelos, definiendo métricas que conecten el desempeño técnico con el resultado de negocio.
Aplicar capacidades de IA Generativa, incluyendo embeddings, RAG, LLMs y NLP, en contextos donde la seguridad y la fiabilidad son esenciales.
Utilizar servicios AWS como S3, SageMaker, Redshift y Glue para desplegar y escalar soluciones.
Comunicar hallazgos y recomendaciones de forma clara a interlocutores técnicos y de negocio.
Aportar liderazgo técnico y acompañar el desarrollo de otras personas del equipo.







¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Al menos 2 años de experiencia en Data Science, analítica avanzada o desarrollo de modelos predictivos, idealmente en banca, servicios financieros, seguros o entornos regulados.
Formación en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Física u otras disciplinas cuantitativas. Se valorará formación de posgrado en Inteligencia Artificial, Ciencia de Datos o Big Data.
Dominio de Python aplicado a ciencia de datos: pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost u otras librerías equivalentes.
Experiencia práctica con PySpark, SQL avanzado y grandes volúmenes de datos.
Conocimiento del ciclo completo de modelado: preparación de datos, entrenamiento, validación, tuning, evaluación y seguimiento.
Experiencia con servicios de AWS orientados a datos y machine learning.
Conocimiento práctico de NLP, LLMs, RAG y embeddings.
Manejo de Git y nivel de inglés avanzado para colaborar en entornos internacionales.
Capacidad para conectar decisiones técnicas con necesidades de negocio y explicarlas con claridad.







Será un plus si además tienes...

Experiencia con prácticas de MLOps y herramientas como MLflow o Airflow.
Participación en despliegues de modelos en producción.
Experiencia visualizando resultados para negocio con Power BI o Looker.
Certificaciones AWS en Data Analytics o Machine Learning.
Contribución a assets, aceleradores o frameworks reutilizables de analítica.







¿Por qué NTT DATA?

NTT DATA reúne el alcance de una compañía global -con más de 139.000 profesionales y presencia en más de 50 países- con equipos que trabajan de forma cercana, compartiendo conocimiento y responsabilidad sobre el resultado.




Aquí podrás profundizar en especialización técnica sin alejarte del negocio. Participarás en proyectos relevantes para grandes organizaciones, colaborarás con profesionales de data, cloud, arquitectura y estrategia, y tendrás oportunidades reales para construir una trayectoria a tu medida.




Además, podrás acceder a:

Modelo de trabajo híbrido, con flexibilidad para adaptar la forma de trabajar al proyecto y al equipo.
Itinerarios de aprendizaje, formación especializada y acompañamiento para desarrollar tu carrera.
Medidas de bienestar, conciliación y beneficios corporativos.
Un entorno donde aportar, aprender y crecer sin perder la cercanía de un equipo que comparte retos.




Make THIS the place to grow.

Trabajarás en la intersección entre negocio, datos e inteligencia artificial: desde la definición del problema hasta la puesta en producción de soluciones que puedan utilizarse y evolucionar.


Formarás parte de equipos multidisciplinares que desarrollan soluciones de datos para banca, combinando modelización predictiva, procesamiento de grandes volúmenes de información e IA Generativa. Tendrás espacio para aportar criterio técnico, traducir necesidades complejas en casos de uso viables y acompañar a perfiles con menor experiencia.



¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

  • Diseñar y desarrollar modelos predictivos y soluciones de analítica avanzada para casos de uso del sector financiero.
  • Trabajar con datos a gran escala mediante Python, PySpark y SQL, asegurando calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad.
  • Construir pipelines de datos y modelado end-to-end, desde la exploración hasta la integración en entornos productivos.
  • Validar, optimizar y evaluar modelos, definiendo métricas que conecten el desempeño técnico con el resultado de negocio.
  • Aplicar capacidades de IA Generativa, incluyendo embeddings, RAG, LLMs y NLP, en contextos donde la seguridad y la fiabilidad son esenciales.
  • Utilizar servicios AWS como S3, SageMaker, Redshift y Glue para desplegar y escalar soluciones.
  • Comunicar hallazgos y recomendaciones de forma clara a interlocutores técnicos y de negocio.
  • Aportar liderazgo técnico y acompañar el desarrollo de otras personas del equipo.



¿Qué buscamos en ti?

  • Al menos 2 años de experiencia en Data Science, analítica avanzada o desarrollo de modelos predictivos, idealmente en banca, servicios financieros, seguros o entornos regulados.
  • Formación en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Física u otras disciplinas cuantitativas. Se valorará formación de posgrado en Inteligencia Artificial, Ciencia de Datos o Big Data.
  • Dominio de Python aplicado a ciencia de datos: pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost u otras librerías equivalentes.
  • Experiencia práctica con PySpark, SQL avanzado y grandes volúmenes de datos.
  • Conocimiento del ciclo completo de modelado: preparación de datos, entrenamiento, validación, tuning, evaluación y seguimiento.
  • Experiencia con servicios de AWS orientados a datos y machine learning.
  • Conocimiento práctico de NLP, LLMs, RAG y embeddings.
  • Manejo de Git y nivel de inglés avanzado para colaborar en entornos internacionales.
  • Capacidad para conectar decisiones técnicas con necesidades de negocio y explicarlas con claridad.



Será un plus si además tienes...

  • Experiencia con prácticas de MLOps y herramientas como MLflow o Airflow.
  • Participación en despliegues de modelos en producción.
  • Experiencia visualizando resultados para negocio con Power BI o Looker.
  • Certificaciones AWS en Data Analytics o Machine Learning.
  • Contribución a assets, aceleradores o frameworks reutilizables de analítica.



¿Por qué NTT DATA?

NTT DATA reúne el alcance de una compañía global -con más de 139.000 profesionales y presencia en más de 50 países- con equipos que trabajan de forma cercana, compartiendo conocimiento y responsabilidad sobre el resultado.


Aquí podrás profundizar en especialización técnica sin alejarte del negocio. Participarás en proyectos relevantes para grandes organizaciones, colaborarás con profesionales de data, cloud, arquitectura y estrategia, y tendrás oportunidades reales para construir una trayectoria a tu medida.


Además, podrás acceder a:

  • Modelo de trabajo híbrido, con flexibilidad para adaptar la forma de trabajar al proyecto y al equipo.
  • Itinerarios de aprendizaje, formación especializada y acompañamiento para desarrollar tu carrera.
  • Medidas de bienestar, conciliación y beneficios corporativos.
  • Un entorno donde aportar, aprender y crecer sin perder la cercanía de un equipo que comparte retos.


Make THIS the place to grow.


Si te interesa aplicar la ciencia de datos a decisiones que importan en banca, ¡queremos conocerte!

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

Job Description

Job Summary: Postdoctoral Scientist (AI/ML)

J&J Innovative Medicine - Productivity AI/ML team is recruiting a Senior Scientist - Data Science. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in utilizing Generative AI (GenAI), machine learning (ML), and natural language processing (NLP) methodologies to promote data-driven and automated clinical operations across various therapeutic areas. The ideal candidate will leverage, adapt, and extend ML and GenAI techniques to create pipelines supporting global clinical operations including enrollment forecasting, cost optimization, and country/site selection. The primary location for this position is Hyderabad, India, with Bangalore, India may be cosidered. Spain and the East Coast of USA are potential options.

J&J Innovative Medicine develops treatments that improve the health of people worldwide. Research and development areas encompass oncology, cardiovascular and metabolic disorders, immunology, pulmonary hypertension, neuroscience, and infectious disease. Our goal is to help people live longer, healthier lives. We have produced and marketed many first-in-class prescription medications and are poised to serve the broad needs of the healthcare market – from patients to practitioners and from clinics to hospitals. To learn more about J&J Innovative Medicine, visit https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

Key Responsibilities


Conceive, develop, and implement GenAI and ML solutions to support clinical trial operations.
Fine tune and adapt large language models (LLMs) to create solutions including conducting comparative analytics on clinical trial protocols, trial similarity assessment, clinical trial data harmonization and standardization, and eligibility criteria evaluation,
Leverage operational data sources and optimization techniques to create tools for developing scenarios with cost and enrollment optimization and deliver supporting real-world data insights,
Contribute to patient modeling and enrollment simulations to have accurate projections for completion of enrollment,
Clearly articulate highly technical methods and results to diverse audiences and partners to drive decision-making.


Required Qualifications


A Ph.D. degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., computer science, statistics, biostatistics, health economics, biomedical informatics, epidemiology, applied mathematics, or similar),
2+ years of industry experience delivering on Data Science projects using predictive technologies, forecasting, multi-objective optimization, natural language processing, artificial intelligence, or machine learning,
Hand-on experience with LLM application framework and tools (e.g., DSPy, LangChain) clinical/medical LLMs and finetuning techniques,
Proficiency with programming languages Python and SQL,
Passionate about leveraging data to drive scientific innovation,
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools,
Demonstrated experience in one of the following domains: real-world data (EHR, insurance claims, registry data), building patient cohorts, enrollment modeling, clinical trial analytics,
Experience working with healthcare professionals,
Ability to effectively communicate technical work to a wide audience.


Thriving on a diverse company culture and celebrating the uniqueness of our employees, we are committed to inclusion. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Johnson & Johnson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

¿Te entusiasma hacer crecer tu carrera?

BBVA es una compañía global con más de 160 años de historia que opera en más de 25 países donde damos servicio a más de 80 millones de clientes. Conoce más sobre el área:

At BBVA AI Factory…

BBVA AI Factory operates as a global hub within the Data area of BBVA, with development centers in Spain, Mexico, and Turkey.

Our mission is to build complete, end-to-end data products that solve BBVA's business needs by working closely with business units to transform strategic priorities into actionable, data-driven solutions. Some of our recent projects include:


Mercury Library, an in-house AI framework now available to the entire data community, aimed at boosting collaboration and accelerating AI solution development. [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/category/mercury/]
A machine learning pipeline designed to enhance early debt recovery by predicting default risk and optimizing collection strategies [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/a-machine-learning-pipeline-for-early-debt-recovery-executive-summary/]
Applying daily life embeddings to drive deeper personalization in customer interactions and improve service recommendations. [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/behind-daily-life-embeddings-in-action/]
Utilizing conformal prediction to provide reliable uncertainty estimates and enhance the confidence in AI model predictions [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/conformal-prediction-an-introduction-to-measuring-uncertainty/]
Building algorithmic explainability frameworks to ensure transparency and foster trust in our AI systems. [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/algorithmic-explainability-how-do-we-apply-it-in-bbva-ai-factory/ ]


At BBVA AI Factory, innovation isn’t just a goal-it’s a continuous journey.

Sobre el puesto

At BBVA AI Factory, we're seeking an Data Scientist to join our dynamic team in Madrid, specializing in the application of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). Our team thrives on collaboration and innovation, tackling complex challenges in finance with state-of-the-art AI solutions. Whether it’s developing explainable algorithms, building Machine Learning pipelines to improve debt recovery, or leveraging LLMs for enhanced customer experiences, we focus on creating real-world impact. As part of our team, you'll build end-to-end data products that incorporate cutting-edge AI to enhance key banking processes. Collaborating with a diverse group of experts, you'll help develop a new AI-supported customer relationship model that benefits both customers and managers.

Key Job Responsibilities


Lead Analytical Projects: Manage and execute key analytical projects within the DATA area, aligning with strategic objectives, while leading analytical teams to ensure successful project delivery.
Data Analysis: Analyze large and complex data sets to uncover trends and insights that drive business decisions.
Model Building: Develop predictive and generative models using statistical, machine learning, and LLM techniques.
LLM Lifecycle Management: Evaluate, fine-tune, and optimize LLM models for domain-specific applications, integrating them into analytical solutions.
Experimental Development: Lead the iterative development of LLM-based solutions, including constructing knowledge bases, datasets, and performance evaluation methodologies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to implement data-driven solutions and integrate LLM capabilities effectively.
Insight Communication: Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization.
Mentorship: Guide and mentor less experienced team members to foster growth and success.
Best Practices Compliance: Ensure all deliverables meet Advanced Analytics governance standards and best practices.


Your Qualifications


Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Experience: 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist , including significant work with LLMs and multidisciplinary projects.
LLM Expertise: Advanced technical knowledge of LLMs, including fine-tuning, prompt engineering, embedding elicitation, and model optimization.
Programming & ML Frameworks: Deep expertise in Python, statistical modeling, and machine learning, with strong proficiency in Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, plus hands-on experience with PySpark, TensorFlow, PyTorch and HuggingFace Transformers; experience with libraries such as LangChain or LangGraph is a plus.
Data Lifecycle Management: Proficiency in the end-to-end lifecycle of ML models, from dataset creation and EDA to testing and monitoring/retraining.
AI Risk Assessment : In-depth understanding of risks inherent to LLMs, such as hallucination, biases, and unpredictability.
Applied Machine Learning: Deep knowledge of a broad set of machine learning techniques applied to solve complex business problems, including A/B testing for model performance.
Communication Skills: Excellent ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business insights.
Ethical AI and Responsible Data Science: Knowledge of ethical AI principles, data privacy laws (like GDPR, CCPA), and a commitment to responsible data science practices.


Nice to Have


Previous experience in the financial industry.
PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Cloud Computing: Experience in AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure for scalable data science solutions, including experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience in Causality: Knowledge and application of causal inference methods to identify and model cause-and-effect relationships in data


Habilidades:

Empatía, Ética, Innovación, Orientación al cliente, Pensamiento proactivo

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Description

ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.

You will help deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with subject matter experts to frame questions, analyse evidence and deliver findings. This is a hands-on technical and consulting role: you will discuss needs with specialists, present approaches and results to varied audiences, and contribute to proposals. You will join an established team and work across technically diverse projects.

What You Will Do


Speak with subject matter experts and clients to define the problem, success measures, data needs and an appropriate analytical approach.
Prepare and analyse data, develop and evaluate models or prototypes using statistical methods, forecasting, machine learning or language models where suitable.
Present findings, assumptions and limitations to subject matter experts, clients and nontechnical audiences, invite challenge and adapt the work to their feedback.
Collaborate with colleagues across different technical disciplines to document work, make results reproducible and develop promising prototypes into reliable solutions.
Contribute technical ideas, estimates and evidence to proposals, and manage your work across several concurrent projects.
Share methods and reusable approaches with colleagues across the data science team.


What You Will Bring


Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data.
Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures.
Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks.
Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing.
Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use.
Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field.


Useful Additional Experience


Experience working in public policy, government, research or evaluation
Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment.
Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills.


What You Can Expect

You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges from discovery to delivery. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills.

Right to Work, Location & Sponsorship

Role

We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in the world. For roles located in the UK, Belgium, Spain, or Germany, applicants must:


Hold the right to work in the country where the role is based, or be eligible for visa sponsorship, which we may consider on a case-by-case basis, and
Be physically present in that country by their first day of employment (or able to relocate beforehand).


Unless stated otherwise, relocation support is not automatically provided.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist to join our growing team and help deliver innovative machine learning and analytics solutions for complex business challenges. In this customer-facing role, you will work with large-scale datasets, develop advanced analytical models, and collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to drive measurable impact.

Responsibilities

Design and implement data science solutions throughout the project lifecycle.
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Develop and optimize machine learning models and advanced analytics workflows.
Perform feature engineering and data preparation for predictive modeling initiatives.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Lead the data science aspects of customer implementations, pilots, and production deployments.
Build strong technical relationships with customers and external partners.
Provide recommendations to improve products, algorithms, and analytical capabilities.
Deliver training and knowledge transfer to end users and stakeholders.
Support investigation and resolution of data-related and analytical challenges.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
2+ years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or Big Data development.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with PySpark.
Hands-on experience working with large-scale data processing frameworks and machine learning pipelines.
Experience with ML lifecycle and workflow management tools such as MLflow, Airflow, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and statistical modeling skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services, fraud detection, risk analytics, compliance, or transaction monitoring.
Familiarity with cloud-based data and machine learning environments.
Experience investigating anomalies and extracting insights from high-volume datasets.
Knowledge of machine learning model deployment and monitoring best practices.

Technical Skills

PySpark
Python
Apache Spark
Machine Learning
MLflow
Airflow
SQL
Big Data Analytics
Feature Engineering
Statistical Analysis

This role is ideal for a data scientist who enjoys combining advanced analytics, machine learning, and business problem-solving to create impactful, scalable solutions.

Why Join Us?

You’ll work with a talented global team, contribute to meaningful technical initiatives, and help shape a high performing DevOps culture.

Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization.

To learn more, visit: www.matrix-ifs.com

Title: Data Scientist - MLOps
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien.

Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica, la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a Data Scientist con 3-4 años de experiencia.

Formarás parte de un equipo dentro de una gran compañía del sector energético, donde tu trabajo impacta directamente en las decisiones diarias de áreas clave. Serás el enlace técnico entre los datos y el negocio, encargándote del desarrollo y de la puesta en producción tanto de modelos de machine learning clásico como de IA generativa, ayudando el cliente a generar valor a partir de sus proprios datos. Trabajarás sobre un entorno en Azure con una metodología Agile en contacto directo con usuarios y negocio. Los proyectos abarcan distintos casos de uso (forecasting, clasificación, optimización, pricing, etc.) con aplicaciones en todas las áreas de la compañía.

Experiencia sólida en Python.
Buen dominio de la modularización y la programación orientada a objetos.
Experiencia trabajando con Git y buenas prácticas de control de versiones.
Conocimiento en tests unitarios y prácticas de CI/CD.
Se valorará positivamente experiencia con Azure Databricks y Azure Machine Learning (Jobs, Pipelines, YAMLs)
Se valorará experiencia con PySpark.
Familiaridad con herramientas de gestión de tareas como Azure DevOps, Jira o similar
Buen nivel de inglés, tanto oral como escrito.




¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Extraerás y analizarás datos de las bases de datos para impulsar la optimización y la mejora del desarrollo de productos de la Segunda Ola Digital.
Evaluarás la eficacia y precisión de las nuevas fuentes de datos y aplicar técnicas de recopilación de datos.
Desarrollarás modelos personalizados para resolver las iniciativas de IA existentes a partir de los datos disponibles y haciendo uso de algoritmos.
Utilizarás el modelado predictivo para aumentar y optimizar las experiencias de los clientes, la generación de ingresos, la segmentación de anuncios y otros resultados empresariales.
Diseñarás marcos de prueba A / B y determinar siempre una métrica para evaluar los modelos.
Te coordinarás con diferentes equipos funcionales para implementar modelos y monitorizar los resultados.
Desarrollarás procesos y herramientas para supervisar y analizar el rendimiento del modelo y la precisión de los datos.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrado en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas.

Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 36.000 y 40.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa. También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas.

Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid, la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly!

Description:
Role Overview

We are on a mission to harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to shape the next generation of financial intelligence solutions. As we continue to expand our Data Science capability, we are seeking a talented and innovative Data Scientist to develop cutting-edge analytical and Generative AI solutions that drive commercial value across our business.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Únete a CGI!

Fundada en 1976, CGI se encuentra entre las mayores empresas de servicios de consultoría TI y de negocio del mundo. Nos basamos en conocimientos y resultados para ayudar a acelerar la transformación digital de nuestros clientes. A través de 21 sectores en 400 ubicaciones en todo el mundo, nuestros 94.000 profesionales proporcionan servicios de consultoría TI y de negocio integrales, escalables y sostenibles que entregamos localmente.3 years of experience in a similar environment.

Buscamos un/a Data Scientist para incorporarse a un proyecto relevante dentro del sector asegurador, participando en iniciativas de Machine Learning, Inteligencia Artificial y Analítica Avanzada con impacto directo en negocio.




Responsabilidades

Trabajar con diferentes áreas para entender problemas de negocio y traducirlos en casos de uso de Data Science.
Explorar, preparar y analizar datos para identificar patrones y oportunidades.
Diseñar, desarrollar y validar modelos estadísticos y de Machine Learning.
Realizar feature engineering y evaluar diferentes aproximaciones de modelización.
Interpretar los resultados y traducirlos en conclusiones comprensibles y accionables para negocio.
Colaborar con otros perfiles de Data, Engineering y Tecnología para llevar los modelos hacia entornos productivos.
Participar en la evolución y monitorización de modelos una vez desplegados.
Trabajar dentro de un entorno tecnológico moderno de datos y analítica avanzada.




Requisitos

Sobre todo, una persona con una buena base de Data Science y estadística, curiosidad por entender el negocio y ganas de construir soluciones que lleguen a utilizarse en el mundo real.

Nos gustaría que aportaras:

Experiencia profesional desarrollando proyectos de Data Science / Machine Learning.
Buenos conocimientos de estadística y modelización.
Experiencia con técnicas de Machine Learning supervisadas y/o no supervisadas.
Buen nivel de Python y SQL.
Experiencia trabajando con datos desde su exploración y preparación hasta la evaluación de modelos.
Capacidad para entender problemas de negocio y comunicar los resultados de manera clara.
Interés por participar en todo el ciclo de vida de una solución de Data Science y no únicamente en su fase experimental.

Nos ayudará especialmente si además tienes...

Experiencia en sector Seguros o en otros sectores intensivos en datos como banca, fintech, telco, utilities o similares.
Experiencia con Databricks, PySpark o Apache Spark.
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos.
Conocimientos de cloud y MLOps.
Experiencia con modelos ya desplegados en producción y su monitorización.
Conocimiento de problemáticas como fraude, pricing/riesgo, propensión, churn, segmentación, forecasting, recomendación o customer analytics.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Title: Data Scientist III - Analytics
Description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To The Team

The online travel market never stands still. Within our B2B team we're smack in the middle of it! We are an entrepreneurial start-up operating in the B2B market within the world's biggest travel company. We build the tools and technology that help millions of travelers find the perfect hotels for their next trips. We are the largest and fastest-growing travel affiliate network, working with over 10,000 partners in 33 countries to turn their web traffic into hotel bookings and loyal customers.

The Data Scientist III (Revenue Optimization – Analytics/Strategy) is an exciting role within our B2B Analytics Team. This person will primarily be responsible for collaborating with commercial stakeholders and Machine Learning teams to design Revenue Optimization initiatives that enhance competitiveness and accelerate revenue growth for Expedia's multi-billion-dollar B2B business. Key responsibilities include careful analysis of elasticity curves to understand implications of Revenue Optimization actions, deep understanding of the impact that our algorithms have on the business, and translate stakeholders’ needs to technical requirements. This person will work in a small but extremely impactful team, in charge of advising C-level leaders on Revenue Optimization strategy and tactics.

In This Role, You Will


Extract and combine data from multiple sources to support model building and analytics.
Work with commercial stakeholders and Machine Learning teams to design and implement tactical actions that boost both our top- and bottom-line.
Collaborate with stakeholders to iteratively refine project scope and deliverables.
Analyze elasticity curves to take actions aimed at optimizing our partners’ performance
Deep dive into matters such as price, profitability and competitiveness, all this supported by data and statistics
Continuously learn and apply new Data Science approaches to improve project outcomes.


Experience And Qualifications


You are a critical thinker with a curious mindset and strong problem-solving abilities.
You are eager to find business opportunities by analyzing patterns
You are proficient in SQL and Python
Probability and statistics are part of your daily life at work
You understand how Machine Learning Algorithms work under the hood
You are experienced in communicating with both technical and non-technical teams
You are a collaborative team player with a track record of contributing to impactful projects.
You are educated to degree level and have hands-on experience in Data Science or Analytics (4+ years for Bachelors/Masters or 2+ years for PhDs)
You can work in a high-pressure environment with billion dollars at stake
You are comfortable constructively challenging colleagues and the status quo to drive continuous performance improvement


The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €55,500.00 to €78,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €89,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

You can find the benefits for this location and any collective agreement that may apply here.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Title: Data Scientist – Time Series Forecasting
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien.

Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica, la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a Data Scientist enfocado en forecasting de series temporales para el área de Finanzas con 2-3 años de experiencia en responsabilidades similares. Perfil con base técnica sólida —escribe buen código y se maneja con soltura en el desarrollo, aunque la productivización final se aborde en colaboración con Data Engineers—, que trabaja de forma autónoma: gestiona su propio tiempo, toma la iniciativa sin dirección constante y da visibilidad proactiva de su avance. Comunica resultados e implicaciones de negocio por sí mismo/a, sin necesidad de supervisión constante.




Imprescindibles:

Grado en Data Science, Informática, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Finanzas cuantitativas o afín (MS/PhD valorable).
Python sólido, con buenas prácticas de desarrollo (código limpio, testeado, versionado).
PySpark para procesamiento distribuido de datos a gran escala.
Experiencia demostrable en forecasting de series temporales (clásico y/o ML).
Aplicación de técnicas de ML sobre datasets grandes (clustering, clasificación, regresión, detección de anomalías).
Mentalidad de optimización y rendimiento: diseña con el rendimiento en mente y propone mejoras que impactan en métricas (tiempos de procesamiento, consumo de recursos).
SQL para acceso y transformación de datos.
Comprensión sólida de metodologías ágiles.
Inglés profesional.




Será un PLUS:

Dominio financiero (planificación, riesgo, FP&A, tesorería).

Title: Data Scientist (Time Series Forecasting)
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Scientist (Time Series Forecasting) based in Spain.

Join a data-driven team developing advanced forecasting solutions that power a live energy trading platform. In this role, you will build and optimize time series models to predict weather conditions, energy market prices, and electricity grid supply and demand. Your work will directly support data-informed trading decisions by transforming analytical models into reliable, production-ready code. You will collaborate in a fully remote, distributed environment where quantitative expertise, technical excellence, and practical problem-solving are highly valued. Leveraging Python, SQL, and modern AI-powered coding tools, you will help bridge the gap between sophisticated forecasting techniques and real-world business applications. This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on data scientist who enjoys solving complex prediction challenges and delivering measurable impact in the evolving energy sector.

Accountabilities


Time Series Forecasting: Design, develop, and refine forecasting models for weather conditions, energy market prices, and electricity grid supply and demand.
Production Model Development: Translate forecasting algorithms and analytical models into robust, scalable, production-ready code that integrates with and powers a live energy trading platform.
Data Analysis & Model Optimization: Analyze relevant datasets, identify patterns and trends, and improve forecasting accuracy to support reliable, data-driven trading decisions.
AI-Assisted Development: Incorporate agentic coding tools into daily development workflows to accelerate implementation, improve productivity, and support efficient software development.
Technical Integration: Work with data pipelines, analytical systems, and production environments to ensure forecasting solutions are reliable, maintainable, and suitable for operational use.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical findings, explain forecasting approaches, and collaborate effectively with distributed teams to align model development with business and platform requirements.


Requirements


Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or higher in Mathematics, Econometrics, Physics, Engineering, or another closely related quantitative discipline.
Professional Experience: At least three years of relevant professional experience in data science, quantitative analysis, forecasting, or a related field.
Time Series Forecasting Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing and applying time series forecasting models, with the ability to translate quantitative methods into practical solutions.
Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, model development, and production implementation. Experience with Go is considered an advantage.
Agentic Coding Tools: Regular, hands-on use of agentic coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, with the ability to integrate AI-assisted techniques effectively into software development.
Communication Skills: Excellent English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and collaborate with stakeholders in a remote, international environment.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong quantitative reasoning, attention to detail, and a practical approach to addressing complex forecasting challenges and improving model performance.
Preferred Industry Knowledge: Experience working with energy markets, electricity trading, power grid data, or weather datasets is a plus.


Benefits


Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in a distributed team environment.
International Collaboration: Opportunity to contribute to a global energy trading platform and collaborate with professionals across different locations.
Meaningful Technical Impact: Develop forecasting solutions that support real-world energy market decisions and operational trading activities.
Advanced Data Science Challenges: Work on practical applications of time series forecasting involving weather, market prices, and electricity supply and demand.
Modern Development Practices: Use agentic coding tools and contemporary development workflows to improve productivity and streamline model implementation.
Professional Growth: Strengthen your expertise in quantitative modeling, production-grade data science, and applied forecasting in the energy sector.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
OGC is a boutique market research and data analysis consulting firm specializing in customer experience analytics, innovation testing, and data visualization. We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our team.




Our mission is to help our clients become more insightful, create happier end customers, and uncover opportunities to grow their businesses. We employ a hands-on approach to research and consulting: we follow a comprehensive discovery process, apply advanced analysis techniques using state-of-the-art tools, draw conclusions collaboratively in cross-functional teams, and utilize workshops to foster action.




Our client portfolio is international, with a focus on US-based, Fortune 500 companies, across a variety of industries such as Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software.




This position follows U.S. East Coast (ET) hours.




The ideal candidate for this position is a bright, independent, detail-oriented individual, with a strong analytical background, who is passionate about using data to help customers drive strategic decisions and business improvements. They are a methodological problem solver who is driven by curiosity to find answers to challenging puzzles. We are looking for a candidate who loves working with people, has an excellent business acumen, and who is always eager to learn. Our data scientists are self-starters, with a strong technical background and a deep familiarity with data analysis and quantitative research methodologies.




In this role, you will work directly with our clients and deliver consulting projects to senior stakeholders, with the end goal of leveraging data to help our clients drive strategic decisions and business improvements. This position provides an excellent opportunity to apply your strong analytical background to the Market Research and Customer Experience domain while working directly with global, Fortune 500 companies.




Responsibilities include

Support the execution of quantitative research and consulting projects from start to finish including project planning, data analysis, modeling, and building insights-based reports
Work with other data scientists, designers, and project managers on interdisciplinary projects using your skillset to derive structure and knowledge from raw data across various industry sectors
Work on complex and varied data sets from some of the world’s largest organizations to solve real-world problems
Develop data science products and solutions for clients, as well as for our internal team
Client Communication and engagement including building and delivering insights-based reports
Build, deploy and automate various algorithms (classification, regression, forecasting) and support the production of automated reports and analysis
Transform large volumes of data from internal and external sources in a manner suitable for analysis
Research new data sources, analytical tools, and methodologies for data science and data engineering
Perform complex data analysis in support of ad-hoc and standing requests, focusing on delivering key insights
Provide an expert point of view on analytical techniques and guidance to our analysts and sales directors




Requirements

Bachelor’s degree from a top university
MA/MS in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or other quantitative field - An advantage
4+ years of professional experience as a project-oriented data analyst or scientist
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze issues, identify causes, and recommend solutions quickly
Strong quantitative background with a high comfort level for learning new technologies
Diverse technical skills including:
Python (High Level)
Modeling/Machine Learning
Statistics
SQL
Excel (VBA, Power Pivot, Power Query, DAX - An advantage)
Data Visualization (Tableau, PowerBI - An advantage)
Demonstrated experience with common Python packages for data analysis and modeling; including Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Jupyter, Dask, PySpark, etc. - An advantage
Expertise in one or more specific data science domains (geospatial analytics, dashboards, text analytics, causal inference, cloud computing, etc.) - An advantage
Must speak and write English fluently and idiomatically

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About the job




We are seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist to join our growing team and help deliver innovative machine learning and analytics solutions for complex business challenges. In this customer-facing role, you will work with large-scale datasets, develop advanced analytical models, and collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to drive measurable impact.

This role is ideal for a data scientist who enjoys combining advanced analytics, machine learning, and business problem-solving to create impactful, scalable solutions.




Responsibilities




Design and implement data science solutions throughout the project lifecycle.
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Develop and optimize machine learning models and advanced analytics workflows.
Perform feature engineering and data preparation for predictive modeling initiatives.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Lead the data science aspects of customer implementations, pilots, and production deployments.
Build strong technical relationships with customers and external partners.
Provide recommendations to improve products, algorithms, and analytical capabilities.
Deliver training and knowledge transfer to end users and stakeholders.
Support investigation and resolution of data-related and analytical challenges.




Requirements




Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
2+ years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or Big Data development.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with PySpark.
Hands-on experience working with large-scale data processing frameworks and machine learning pipelines.
Experience with ML lifecycle and workflow management tools such as MLflow, Airflow, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and statistical modeling skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders is a plus.




Advantages




Experience in financial services, fraud detection, risk analytics, compliance, or transaction monitoring.
Familiarity with cloud-based data and machine learning environments.
Experience investigating anomalies and extracting insights from high-volume datasets.
Knowledge of machine learning model deployment and monitoring best practices.




What we can offer




Additional 20 days of paid leave
Professional and career benefits
Top-quality work environment
Online courses
Online sports activities
Team Buildings and Christmas Parties

¿Te interesaría seguir desarrollándote como Data Scientist/Forecasting ML Engineer en un entorno tecnológico de alto rendimiento, participando en proyectos complejos e innovadores en el sector biofarmaceútico?




En Oxigent Technologies buscamos un/a Científico/a del Dato para incorporarse a nuestra área de IT. Formarás parte de un equipo de Oxigent ubicado en Madrid pero con posibilidad de trabajo 100%.




La MISIÓN PRINCIPAL será la transformación de la infraestructura de MLOps para automatizar y escalar el motor de predicción de demanda de la compañía, evolucionando los modelos hacia una arquitectura robusta y modular en Python que garantice predicciones precisas, integradas y preparadas para la expansión internacional.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?




• Desarrollo de forecasting: Desarrollar y perfeccionar los modelos de series temporales para la predicción precisa de la demanda.

• Diseño de algoritmos de optimización: Crear y ajustar la lógica algorítmica que cuadra las predicciones con los condicionantes de negocio.

• Paso a código (Scripting): Refactorizar el código exploratorio de Dataiku/Notebooks a scripts de Python limpios, modulares y mantenibles.

• Procesamiento de datos en Snowflake: Extraer, limpiar y estructurar grandes volúmenes de datos directamente desde Snowflake para alimentar los modelos.

• Sinergia con MLOps: Colaborar codo con codo con el MLOps Architect para adaptar la lógica de entrenamiento e inferencia a contenedores y pipelines.




Para ello, ¿qué vas a necesitar?




• Years of experience: 4 años.

• Languages: Español. Inglés B2 para poder comunicarse con un equipo internacional.

• Technical skills: Python. Time series Forecasting.

• Valuable technical skills: Snowflake. Nociones de MLOps. Feature Engineering & ML training.

• Soft skills: Capacidad de colaboración. Autonomía.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?




• Estabilidad desde el primer día, con contratación indefinida a través de Oxigent.

• Salario acorde al perfil y a la experiencia aportada (entre 48.000-53.000 € anuales.).

• Horario flexible.

• Modelo Remoto 100% con posibilidad de asistir a las oficinas de Madrid.

• Cheque de Formación anual para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.

• Seguro médico privado.

• Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.

• Plan de pensiones con aportación empresarial complementaria.

• App de bienestar con acceso a gimnasios, actividades deportivas y profesionales especializados a precios reducidos.

• Eventos, afterworks y actividades solidarias para desconectar, compartir y conocer al equipo.

¡Únete al equipo de Oxigent! Empresa comprometida con la sostenibilidad y la igualdad de oportunidades, donde el talento y la tecnología no entienden de género.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (GenAI & Customer Analytics)
Description:
Si para ti un modelo no termina cuando funciona en un notebook, sino cuando se convierte en una decisión, se activa en CRM, Media o Commerce y demuestra su impacto en negocio, tenemos que hablar.

En WAM buscamos a una persona que nos ayude a construir nuestra capacidad de Analytics, AI y Decisioning. Tu rol no será solo modelar: diseñarás modelos de Customer Intelligence y Growth y soluciones de GenAI y agentes, trabajarás con el cliente desde el discovery hasta la definición de acciones, y convertirás lo aprendido en activos reutilizables del Studio.




Lo que harás (de verdad):

Customer Intelligence y Growth

Diseñar y desarrollar modelos de segmentación, churn, propensity, LTV, forecasting, recomendación y optimización.

GenAI y Agentes

Construir soluciones de GenAI y agentes que automaticen análisis, generación de insights, recomendaciones y flujos de decisión.

Activación y Medición de Impacto

Conectar modelos y agentes con CRM, Loyalty, Media, Commerce y otros ecosistemas de activación, trabajando junto al equipo de Data Engineering.
Definir marcos de medición, experimentación e incrementalidad para cuantificar el impacto y optimizar decisiones.

Cliente, Activos y Preventa

Participar con el cliente desde el discovery hasta la presentación de resultados y la definición de acciones.
Crear activos propios de WAM, como modelos reutilizables, agentes, aceleradores, demos y metodologías.
Apoyar el offering y la preventa aterrizando casos de uso, solución técnica, esfuerzo y viabilidad.




Crecemos contigo, cuidamos de ti:

Horario flexible: Conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional.
Modelo híbrido: Nos vemos 2 días a la semana en la oficina, pero siempre con máxima flexibilidad.
Banda salarial: Entre 50K-60K € brutos anuales.
Días especiales: Día libre en tu cumpleaños y el 24 y 31 de diciembre.
Plan de Igualdad: Impulsamos la participación equitativa, el respeto y oportunidades justas para todas las personas.
Retribución Flexible: Accede a nuestro plan con Cobee.
Desarrollo profesional: Plan de desarrollo adaptado a tu perfil e inquietudes.
Jornada intensiva: Viernes hasta las 15:00h. Además este año en verano (22/06 al 11/09) y Navidad (desde el 21/12 al 8/01) trabajamos de 8 a 15.




Imprescindible (si no encaja con tu perfil, no es tu rol):

Experiencia: 5+ años en Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning o AI aplicada a negocio.
Python y SQL: Nivel avanzado, con capacidad hands-on para trabajar de forma autónoma con datos y modelos.
Modelado: Experiencia real desarrollando modelos predictivos y/o de optimización sobre problemas de negocio.
GenAI y agentes: Experiencia práctica con LLMs y GenAI. Necesitamos que hayas construido soluciones con RAG, agentes, tool calling, APIs o frameworks de orquestación.
Visión end-to-end: Capacidad para llevar un caso de uso desde el dato y el modelo hasta la decisión, la activación y la medición de impacto.
Datos de negocio: Experiencia con datos de cliente, marketing, comercial o digital, y comprensión de sus principales casos de uso.
Cloud e industrialización: Experiencia en al menos un entorno cloud (GCP, Azure o AWS) y conocimiento de prácticas de industrialización, Git y APIs.
Interlocución con cliente: Capacidad para explicar decisiones técnicas en términos de impacto de negocio.




Suma puntos si tienes:

Customer Intelligence y medición: Experiencia en CRM/Loyalty, MMM/MROI, causalidad, experimentación y optimización.
Ecosistema y operación: Experiencia con Salesforce / Data Cloud, MLOps/LLMOps o evaluación de agentes.

Contribute to prototypes using methods suited to the problem, including language models where appropriate, and test outputs carefully before sharing them.

Care with data quality, documentation and clear, reproducible code, willingness to learn version control and collaborative development practices.
Curiosity about real client problems, willingness to ask questions and ability to explain your thinking in clear written and spoken English.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (GenAI & Customer Analytics)
Description:
Si para ti un modelo no termina cuando funciona en un notebook, sino cuando se convierte en una decisión, se activa en CRM, Media o Commerce y demuestra su impacto en negocio, tenemos que hablar.

En WAM buscamos a una persona que nos ayude a construir nuestra capacidad de Analytics, AI y Decisioning. Tu rol no será solo modelar: diseñarás modelos de Customer Intelligence y Growth y soluciones de GenAI y agentes, trabajarás con el cliente desde el discovery hasta la definición de acciones, y convertirás lo aprendido en activos reutilizables del Studio.

Lo que harás (de verdad):

Customer Intelligence y Growth


Diseñar y desarrollar modelos de segmentación, churn, propensity, LTV, forecasting, recomendación y optimización.


GenAI y Agentes


Construir soluciones de GenAI y agentes que automaticen análisis, generación de insights, recomendaciones y flujos de decisión.


Activación y Medición de Impacto


Conectar modelos y agentes con CRM, Loyalty, Media, Commerce y otros ecosistemas de activación, trabajando junto al equipo de Data Engineering.
Definir marcos de medición, experimentación e incrementalidad para cuantificar el impacto y optimizar decisiones.


Cliente, Activos y Preventa


Participar con el cliente desde el discovery hasta la presentación de resultados y la definición de acciones.
Crear activos propios de WAM, como modelos reutilizables, agentes, aceleradores, demos y metodologías.
Apoyar el offering y la preventa aterrizando casos de uso, solución técnica, esfuerzo y viabilidad.


Crecemos contigo, cuidamos de ti:


Horario flexible: Conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional.
Modelo híbrido: Nos vemos 2 días a la semana en la oficina, pero siempre con máxima flexibilidad.
Banda salarial: Entre 50K-60K € brutos anuales.
Días especiales: Día libre en tu cumpleaños y el 24 y 31 de diciembre.
Plan de Igualdad: Impulsamos la participación equitativa, el respeto y oportunidades justas para todas las personas.
Retribución Flexible: Accede a nuestro plan con Cobee.
Desarrollo profesional: Plan de desarrollo adaptado a tu perfil e inquietudes.
Jornada intensiva: Viernes hasta las 15:00h. Además este año en verano (22/06 al 11/09) y Navidad (desde el 21/12 al 8/01) trabajamos de 8 a 15.


Imprescindible (si no encaja con tu perfil, no es tu rol):


Experiencia: 5+ años en Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning o AI aplicada a negocio.
Python y SQL: Nivel avanzado, con capacidad hands-on para trabajar de forma autónoma con datos y modelos.
Modelado: Experiencia real desarrollando modelos predictivos y/o de optimización sobre problemas de negocio.
GenAI y agentes: Experiencia práctica con LLMs y GenAI. Necesitamos que hayas construido soluciones con RAG, agentes, tool calling, APIs o frameworks de orquestación.
Visión end-to-end: Capacidad para llevar un caso de uso desde el dato y el modelo hasta la decisión, la activación y la medición de impacto.
Datos de negocio: Experiencia con datos de cliente, marketing, comercial o digital, y comprensión de sus principales casos de uso.
Cloud e industrialización: Experiencia en al menos un entorno cloud (GCP, Azure o AWS) y conocimiento de prácticas de industrialización, Git y APIs.
Interlocución con cliente: Capacidad para explicar decisiones técnicas en términos de impacto de negocio.


Suma puntos si tienes:


Customer Intelligence y medición: Experiencia en CRM/Loyalty, MMM/MROI, causalidad, experimentación y optimización.
Ecosistema y operación: Experiencia con Salesforce / Data Cloud, MLOps/LLMOps o evaluación de agentes.

Title: Data Scientist GenAI (LLMs)
Description:
¿Te entusiasma hacer crecer tu carrera?

BBVA es una compañía global con más de 160 años de historia que opera en más de 25 países donde damos servicio a más de 80 millones de clientes. Somos más de 121.000 profesionales trabajando en equipos multidisciplinares con perfiles tan diversos como financieros, expertos legales, científicos de datos, desarrolladores, ingenieros y diseñadores.

Conoce más sobre el área:

At BBVA AI Factory…

BBVA AI Factory operates as a global hub within the Data area of BBVA, with development centers in Spain, Mexico, and Turkey.

Our mission is to build complete, end-to-end data products that solve BBVA's business needs by working closely with business units to transform strategic priorities into actionable, data-driven solutions. Some of our recent projects include:


Mercury Library, an in-house AI framework now available to the entire data community, aimed at boosting collaboration and accelerating AI solution development. [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/category/mercury/]
A machine learning pipeline designed to enhance early debt recovery by predicting default risk and optimizing collection strategies [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/a-machine-learning-pipeline-for-early-debt-recovery-executive-summary/]
Applying daily life embeddings to drive deeper personalization in customer interactions and improve service recommendations. [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/behind-daily-life-embeddings-in-action/]
Utilizing conformal prediction to provide reliable uncertainty estimates and enhance the confidence in AI model predictions [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/conformal-prediction-an-introduction-to-measuring-uncertainty/]
Building algorithmic explainability frameworks to ensure transparency and foster trust in our AI systems. [https://www.bbvaaifactory.com/algorithmic-explainability-how-do-we-apply-it-in-bbva-ai-factory/ ]


At BBVA AI Factory, innovation isn’t just a goal-it’s a continuous journey.

Sobre el puesto

At BBVA AI Factory, we're seeking an Data Scientist to join our dynamic team in Madrid, specializing in the application of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). Our team thrives on collaboration and innovation, tackling complex challenges in finance with state-of-the-art AI solutions. Whether it’s developing explainable algorithms, building Machine Learning pipelines to improve debt recovery, or leveraging LLMs for enhanced customer experiences, we focus on creating real-world impact. As part of our team, you'll build end-to-end data products that incorporate cutting-edge AI to enhance key banking processes. Collaborating with a diverse group of experts, you'll help develop a new AI-supported customer relationship model that benefits both customers and managers.

Key Job Responsibilities


Lead Analytical Projects: Manage and execute key analytical projects within the DATA area, aligning with strategic objectives, while leading analytical teams to ensure successful project delivery.
Data Analysis: Analyze large and complex data sets to uncover trends and insights that drive business decisions.
Model Building: Develop predictive and generative models using statistical, machine learning, and LLM techniques.
LLM Lifecycle Management: Evaluate, fine-tune, and optimize LLM models for domain-specific applications, integrating them into analytical solutions.
Experimental Development: Lead the iterative development of LLM-based solutions, including constructing knowledge bases, datasets, and performance evaluation methodologies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to implement data-driven solutions and integrate LLM capabilities effectively.
Insight Communication: Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization.
Mentorship: Guide and mentor less experienced team members to foster growth and success.
Best Practices Compliance: Ensure all deliverables meet Advanced Analytics governance standards and best practices.


Your Qualifications


Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Experience: 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist , including significant work with LLMs and multidisciplinary projects.
LLM Expertise: Advanced technical knowledge of LLMs, including fine-tuning, prompt engineering, embedding elicitation, and model optimization.
Programming & ML Frameworks: Deep expertise in Python, statistical modeling, and machine learning, with strong proficiency in Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, plus hands-on experience with PySpark, TensorFlow, PyTorch and HuggingFace Transformers; experience with libraries such as LangChain or LangGraph is a plus.
Data Lifecycle Management: Proficiency in the end-to-end lifecycle of ML models, from dataset creation and EDA to testing and monitoring/retraining.
AI Risk Assessment : In-depth understanding of risks inherent to LLMs, such as hallucination, biases, and unpredictability.
Applied Machine Learning: Deep knowledge of a broad set of machine learning techniques applied to solve complex business problems, including A/B testing for model performance.
Communication Skills: Excellent ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business insights.
Ethical AI and Responsible Data Science: Knowledge of ethical AI principles, data privacy laws (like GDPR, CCPA), and a commitment to responsible data science practices.


Nice to Have


Previous experience in the financial industry.
PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Cloud Computing: Experience in AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure for scalable data science solutions, including experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience in Causality: Knowledge and application of causal inference methods to identify and model cause-and-effect relationships in data


Habilidades:

Empatía, Ética, Innovación, Orientación al cliente, Pensamiento proactivo

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Description

ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.

You will help deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with subject matter experts to frame questions, analyse evidence and deliver findings. This is a hands-on technical and consulting role: you will discuss needs with specialists, present approaches and results to varied audiences, and contribute to proposals. You will join an established team and work across technically diverse projects.

What You Will Do


Speak with subject matter experts and clients to define the problem, success measures, data needs and an appropriate analytical approach.
Prepare and analyse data, develop and evaluate models or prototypes using statistical methods, forecasting, machine learning or language models where suitable.
Present findings, assumptions and limitations to subject matter experts, clients and nontechnical audiences, invite challenge and adapt the work to their feedback.
Collaborate with colleagues across different technical disciplines to document work, make results reproducible and develop promising prototypes into reliable solutions.
Contribute technical ideas, estimates and evidence to proposals, and manage your work across several concurrent projects.
Share methods and reusable approaches with colleagues across the data science team.


What You Will Bring


Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data.
Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures.
Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks.
Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing.
Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use.
Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field.


Useful Additional Experience


Experience working in public policy, government, research or evaluation
Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment.
Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills.


What You Can Expect

You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges from discovery to delivery. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills.

Right to Work, Location & Sponsorship

Role

We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in the world. For roles located in the UK, Belgium, Spain, or Germany, applicants must:


Hold the right to work in the country where the role is based, or be eligible for visa sponsorship, which we may consider on a case-by-case basis, and
Be physically present in that country by their first day of employment (or able to relocate beforehand).


Unless stated otherwise, relocation support is not automatically provided.

#Indeed

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodations that involve the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.
