Title: Staff Data Scientist - Paid Marketing Optimization
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

At Preply, we're growing a talented Data Team to empower top-notch decision-making across our organization. Our team collaborates closely with various other chapters - including product, business, and platform - leveraging analysis, experimentation, causal inference, and machine learning.

You’ll be embedded in cross-functional teams, partnering with our MarTech Product Manager, Marketeers, Tech Leads, and the Data Strategy team. Check out our Tech Radar to see the tools and technologies we love using at Preply!

About this role:

This role requires a real interest in the marketing bidding universe and the ability to work with a lot of ambiguity. You will go deep into each channel, understand its bidding and optimization behavior, and derive data driven solutions to increase each channel's ROI through bidding, audience and creative optimization. Marketing brings the business questions, you define the success metrics and the modeling approach to answer them. A lot of this is untapped territory and there is nothing off the shelf to buy, so inventing the approach and convincing your stakeholders of it is a big part of the job.

What you’ll be doing:


Design our Creative Analytics framework (creative performance modeling) - Own, design and develop our Creative Analytics Framework. Drive its findings into decisions with the creative and media-buying teams, and automate detection, reporting and action with MarTech. Longer term, build models that separate what a creative actually causes from what the algorithm’s delivery decides for it, so we can predict the incremental drivers of creative efficiency.
Cohort maturity prediction (conversion-lag prediction) - Minimize steering delay: predict how many of today’s clicks will convert, and connect today’s spend to conversions that haven’t happened yet.
Bidding signal optimization (value-based bidding) - Work with our channel managers and Applied AI team to improve the predicted conversion value we send to Google and Meta, iterating through which funnel events we optimise on and what predictions we attach to them. Predict too early and the signal is noisy, too late and the algorithm doesn’t get enough data to learn from.
Audience optimization (uplift modeling) - Create customer uplift models to identify incremental value and build audiences that improve marketing efficiency. Tell the networks who to look for and who to skip, and feed that back as prospecting seeds, remarketing audiences and exclusion lists.
Work closely with the Data Engineering and Applied AI team on scalable data pipelines, the evolution of our ETL processes, and the adoption of new tools and frameworks.


What you need to succeed:


Python, SQL and a distributed framework like Spark; we use Databricks.
Experience with marketing or attribution data, and a working understanding of how bidding platforms consume the signal you send them. You don't need to have run campaigns, but you should find how they behave genuinely interesting.
Advanced modelling. Propensity models to value earlier funnel events and refine targeting, and uplift models to identify incremental value.
Causal inference and experiment design. Separating what a channel drives from what it takes credit for, and designing the test that settles it when the platform controls delivery.
The instinct to turn a business hypothesis into something testable, and the honesty to say when the data can't answer it.
Comfort working across teams you don't control. This role runs on close collaboration with Applied AI, marketing measurement, MarTech and tracking, and CRM.


You might come from marketing DS, ads ML, recommender systems or any applied ML role where your model’s output fed another algorithm.

Why you’ll love it at Preply:


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

This role requires a real interest in the marketing bidding universe and the ability to work with a lot of ambiguity. You will go deep into each channel, understand its bidding and optimization behavior, and derive data driven solutions to increase each channel's ROI through bidding, audience and creative optimization. Marketing brings the business questions, you define the success metrics and the modeling approach to answer them. A lot of this is untapped territory and there is nothing off the shelf to buy, so inventing the approach and convincing your stakeholders of it is a big part of the job.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design our Creative Analytics framework (creative performance modeling) - Own, design and develop our Creative Analytics Framework. Drive its findings into decisions with the creative and media-buying teams, and automate detection, reporting and action with MarTech. Longer term, build models that separate what a creative actually causes from what the algorithm’s delivery decides for it, so we can predict the incremental drivers of creative efficiency.
  • Cohort maturity prediction (conversion-lag prediction) - Minimize steering delay: predict how many of today’s clicks will convert, and connect today’s spend to conversions that haven’t happened yet.
  • Bidding signal optimization (value-based bidding) - Work with our channel managers and Applied AI team to improve the predicted conversion value we send to Google and Meta, iterating through which funnel events we optimise on and what predictions we attach to them. Predict too early and the signal is noisy, too late and the algorithm doesn’t get enough data to learn from.
  • Audience optimization (uplift modeling) - Create customer uplift models to identify incremental value and build audiences that improve marketing efficiency. Tell the networks who to look for and who to skip, and feed that back as prospecting seeds, remarketing audiences and exclusion lists.
  • Work closely with the Data Engineering and Applied AI team on scalable data pipelines, the evolution of our ETL processes, and the adoption of new tools and frameworks.

What you need to succeed:

  • Python, SQL and a distributed framework like Spark; we use Databricks.
  • Experience with marketing or attribution data, and a working understanding of how bidding platforms consume the signal you send them. You don't need to have run campaigns, but you should find how they behave genuinely interesting.
  • Advanced modelling. Propensity models to value earlier funnel events and refine targeting, and uplift models to identify incremental value.
  • Causal inference and experiment design. Separating what a channel drives from what it takes credit for, and designing the test that settles it when the platform controls delivery.
  • The instinct to turn a business hypothesis into something testable, and the honesty to say when the data can't answer it.
  • Comfort working across teams you don't control. This role runs on close collaboration with Applied AI, marketing measurement, MarTech and tracking, and CRM.

You might come from marketing DS, ads ML, recommender systems or any applied ML role where your model’s output fed another algorithm.

Why you’ll love it at Preply:

  • An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
  • A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
  • A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

  • Access to free mental health support platforms;

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be a key player in shaping the future of our product and driving our strategy forward. Focus on the continuous improvement of our platform by gathering and analyzing data to uncover valuable insights that will shape product evolution and strategy.

Quantify and model the impact of new product features and initiatives, identifying growth opportunities and contributing to the prioritization of our product roadmap.
Help define key performance indicators, tracking events, and engagement metrics that align with business goals and product improvements.
Design, execute, and evaluate large-scale experiments to test new ideas and measure their effectiveness in driving business outcomes.
Build strong relationships with data and technical leaders to foster collaboration and drive cross-team initiatives.

Experience in data analytics working with product teams, experimenting and uncovering opportunities for product optimization.
Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests with a strong grasp of relevant statistical concepts.
Strong understanding of data analysis concepts such as conversion, LTV, cohort analysis, retention, etc.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python), with the ability to write efficient and scalable code.
Curiosity, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, as well as the ability to proactively identify and address challenges.
Ability to craft compelling stories with data and communicate complex insights in a clear and engaging way, driving change among diverse stakeholders.
Interest in the bigger picture, feeling excited to impact the product roadmap and strategy.


Nice to have


Background in 2-sided marketplaces or digital businesses (B2B, B2C, B2B2C).
Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap).
Familiarity with machine learning techniques and how they can be applied to enhance user behavior predictions or product recommendations.
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field.
Previous experience in mentoring or coaching others.

An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
En Mango vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

En MANGO, estamos comprometidos en convertirnos en una empresa impulsada por datos y estamos formando un equipo de Data y Advanced Analytics compuesto por más de 50 profesionales. Este equipo incluye perfiles como ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Big Data Engineers y Software Engineers, con el objetivo de desarrollar plataformas de vanguardia. Estas plataformas permitirán a nuestros squads analíticos crear soluciones innovadoras basadas en Inteligencia Artificial.

El equipo de Advanced Analytics está compuesto por el squad de IA generativa centrado en iniciativas con algoritmos generativos y en el desarrollo de una plataforma interna basada en LLM. El squad de personalización, que crea algoritmos para ofrecer experiencias personalizadas y recomendaciones de productos en tiempo real en mango.com; el squad de Pricing, que optimiza promociones y descuentos para mejorar el margen de la compañía. Y finalmente, el squad de Producto se focaliza en mejorar las decisiones en los primeros pasos de la creación de la colección.

Para este último squad, estamos buscando un/a Senior Data Scientist, preferiblemente con experiencia en el sector retail-fashion para trabajar en proyectos como la optimización de las cantidades de compra para nuevas colecciones, el assortment planning (donde se optimiza la asignación de productos a tiendas), la optimización de las últimas unidades de stock online para su venta en las tiendas más rentables, y un asistente basado en IA generativa para crear reportes y obtener recomendaciones de acciones. Description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits

Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office

About Our Data Science Teams

We're looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. You'll have the opportunity to super charge our user engagement and help us to build a bank that customers truly love.

At Monzo, we're building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 15 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives data scientists the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.

How We Hire

We are excited to be expanding and are hiring for multiple roles across our Data Science teams! Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth, or Core, we are looking for talented individuals with a versatile skill set to contribute across our squads. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!

Your day-to-day


Applying your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand how our users interact with our products and how those insights can inform our product strategy
Guide and enable product teams to measure things that matter; initiate or help run A/B experiments to keep improving everything we do
Drive together with the finance team a unified company-wide understanding of the lifetime value of our users and how different product features are impacting user profitability
Liaise with engineers to keep making sure we collect the right data to produce relevant business insights


You Should Apply If


You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, product, users and very importantly your colleagues as well
You're commercially minded and can put numbers into business perspective
You’re as comfortable getting hands-on as taking a step back and thinking strategically
You have a self-starter mindset ; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so
You're a team player whom your colleagues can rely on
You have solid grounding in SQL and preferably Python
You have experience in conducting large scale A/B experiments


The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:


Recruiter Call
Initial Call
Technical Interview
Final Interview including a case study and collaboration interview


Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.

What’s In It For You

💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits

📍Barcelona, Spain

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of €1,200 a year for books, training courses and conferences

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About The Role

You’ll help make data a core part of how we build and improve HappyRobot’s products.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Machine Learning teams to measure how changes to our models, agents, and product features affect real-world performance. You’ll define meaningful metrics, design experiments, and conduct deeper analyses to understand how our agents create value for clients.

Your work will range from evaluating A/B tests and model changes to analyzing millions of conversations and workflows. You’ll turn complex data into clear insights that influence our product and ML roadmaps.

What You’ll Do


Define and track product, feature, and agent-level metrics.
Design, run, and interpret A/B tests for model changes, prompts, agent behavior, workflows, and product features.
Measure how the performance of our agents affects client outcomes, such as task completion, operational efficiency, response quality, and automation rates.
Connect offline model evaluations with production performance and real-world customer impact.
Conduct deep analyses across conversations, workflows, and product usage to identify opportunities and explain differences in performance.
Investigate anomalies and regressions, perform root-cause analyses, and recommend improvements.
Build statistical models, simulations, and analytical frameworks to support product and ML decisions.
Partner with Engineering to improve instrumentation, data quality, experimentation systems, and analytical data models.
Build dashboards and self-serve tools that help teams understand product and agent performance.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Must Have


4+ years of experience in Data Science, Product Analytics, or another highly quantitative product role.
Strong experience with experimental design, A/B testing, statistics, causal inference, and hypothesis-driven analysis.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python.
Experience defining and operationalizing product and feature metrics.
Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous analyses and actionable recommendations.
Strong product instincts and the ability to distinguish statistical significance from meaningful product or customer impact.
Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, or Machine Learning teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to analytical accuracy.
Founder mindset: ownership, independence, curiosity, and willingness to go deep.


Nice to Have


Experience working with large language models, AI agents, generative AI, or other probabilistic ML products.
Experience measuring the production impact of model, prompt, retrieval, or orchestration changes.
Familiarity with ML evaluation systems and the relationship between offline evaluations and online metrics.
Experience analyzing conversational, NLP, speech, or other unstructured data.
Experience with enterprise or B2B products.
Experience combining quantitative analysis with qualitative methods such as conversation reviews, customer feedback, surveys, or user research.
Familiarity with modern analytics infrastructure, data warehouses, experimentation platforms, and business intelligence tools.
Prior experience in a fast-growing startup or other highly ambiguous environment.


Why join us?


Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Extreme Ownership

This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. Title: Data Scientist PhD
Description:
Barcelona, on-site




Causal Foundry is looking for a PhD graduate to join our data science team in Barcelona. You will analyse real-world data, develop and evaluate models, and design analyses that help our partners make better decisions. The role centres on hands-on data science: turning complex questions into rigorous analyses and translating findings into practical improvements.

No professional experience beyond your PhD is required. We welcome candidates moving directly from doctoral research into industry.




The company




Causal Foundry (CF) builds AI products to solve operational challenges across global health, supply chains, industry and education. Our AI platform, Kenkai, helps digital applications use advanced prediction and personalisation methods to improve decisions and outcomes.

Our work combines statistical modelling, machine learning, causal inference and adaptive interventions, including contextual and restless bandits. We collaborate with partners to understand their challenges, develop appropriate solutions and measure their impact.




What you will do




Explore, clean and analyse complex, longitudinal datasets to understand patterns, assess data quality and identify useful insights.
Translate product, health and operational questions into well-defined analytical, predictive or causal problems.
Build and validate models for forecasting, risk stratification, personalisation, resource allocation and decision support.
Design and analyse experiments, and apply causal inference methods to understand what works, for whom and under which conditions.
Evaluate results carefully, accounting for uncertainty, bias, missing data and the limitations of available evidence.
Develop reproducible analyses and clearly documented code in Python and SQL.
Collaborate with ML engineers, data engineers and domain experts to turn analytical findings and models into practical solutions.
Communicate methods, findings and limitations clearly to technical colleagues and partner teams.
Use Causal Foundry products in your work and help improve its analytical capabilities, data quality and usability through feedback to Engineering.
Contribute analyses and technical writing to scientific papers and other research outputs.
Your projects may include work with public-sector and health partners in Rwanda. Some partner collaboration may involve travel.




What we are looking for

A PhD in statistics, computer science, mathematics, physics or a closely related quantitative field.
A strong foundation in statistical modelling and machine learning, with depth in one or more relevant methods.
Experience applying quantitative methods to data through your PhD research or other academic projects.
Strong Python skills and the ability to work with data using SQL.
Experience using AI agents and coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor for data exploration, analysis, modelling and research workflows, with careful validation of generated code and results. Experience gained during your PhD or personal projects is sufficient
An understanding of sound model evaluation, experimental design and the principles of causal inference.
Care for reproducibility, clear documentation and version control.
The ability to work through ambiguous questions, explain methodological choices and recognise the limitations of an analysis.
Curiosity, initiative and a collaborative approach to solving problems.
Experience with contextual bandits or reinforcement learning, time-series forecasting, survival analysis, Bayesian methods, optimisation or recommender systems.
Publications, open-source contributions or other examples of rigorous, reproducible research.




Why Causal Foundry

Apply your research skills to real operational decisions and problems with social impact.
Explore advanced methods and see how they perform when applied, deployed and measured in practice.
Work closely with colleagues across data science, engineering and domain disciplines.
Build experience across the full data science process, from defining a question to evaluating the impact of a solution.
Collaborate with people and partners across cultures and geographies.




This is an on-site role in our Barcelona office. Working hours are 10 am to 7 pm.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – AI & Supply Chain

About Accenture Data & AI For Supply Chain Team

We are a global Center of Excellence specializing in Data & AI for Supply Chain, with a rapidly growing team of 200+ professionals. Our mission is to turn data into a strategic advantage, driving operational excellence, agility, and smarter, faster decision-making across the end-to-end supply chain.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for passionate professionals to join our team and shape the future of intelligent supply chains.

Our Focus Areas



Supply Chain Planning – AI-driven demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and planning solutions to enhance agility and efficiency.

Fulfillment & Network Optimization – Advanced analytics to optimize logistics, warehouse management, distribution, network and last-mile delivery, improving speed, cost, and service levels.

Manufacturing – AI, machine learning, and IoT to drive predictive maintenance, production efficiency, and quality control in smart manufacturing.



Your role

As a Data Scientist in Accenture’s Data & AI for Supply Chain team, you will:



Apply AI, advanced analytics, and optimization techniques to solve complex supply chain challenges.

Engage directly with clients, translating business needs into AI-driven solutions and delivering measurable impact.

Drive business development, contributing to proposals, identifying new opportunities, and shaping innovative AI offerings.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including data scientists, engineers, and business consultants, to implement cutting-edge supply chain solutions



What Skills Are We Looking For?

Basic Qualifications

✔ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

✔ Proficiency in English (additional languages are a plus).

✔ 4+ years of experience in Data & AI or related fields (we are hiring at different experience levels).

Technical Skills

We seek professionals with strong expertise in AI, analytics, and optimization applied to supply chain challenges. While you don’t need to master all of them, experience in multiple areas will be highly valuable. Key skills include:



Programming: Python, R, SQL

Operation Reasearch & Simulation: LP, ILP, Heuristics/Meta-Heuristics, Discrete Events Simulation, digital twins.

Machine Learning & AI: Forecasting, predictive modeling, optimization algorithms.

Generative AI: LLMs, AI-driven scenario generation, synthetic data modeling, and workflow automation.

Cloud & Big Data: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI/ML services.

Supply Chain Solutions: Familiarity with o9, Blue Yonder (BY), SAP IBP, or similar tools.

Data Engineering & Visualization: Large-scale data processing, market solutions/platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, ..), and tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.



 

Soft & Strategic Skills

Beyond technical expertise, we look for professionals who can think strategically, collaborate effectively, and drive impact in complex environments. Key skills include:



Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking: Ability to analyze supply chain challenges and design AI-driven solutions.

Business Acumen: Understanding the impact of AI and analytics on supply chain efficiency, resilience, and cost reduction.

Communication & Stakeholder Management: Ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

Agility & Innovation: Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments, with a passion for continuous learning and innovation.



 

What’s in It for You?

Join Accenture’s Data & AI for Supply Chain team and unlock a challenging and rewarding career, where you will:



Work on high-impact AI & analytics projects with global clients.

Collaborate with a team of 200+ data scientists and engineers, including 20% PhDs in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or Statistics.

Drive cutting-edge AI innovation, including Generative AI applications in supply chain.

Enjoy a flexible, hybrid work model in a Great Place to Work® recognized company.



Additional Benefits:



Comprehensive insurance (medical, life, and accident).

Wellness programs and medical services.

Flexible compensation programs & stock purchase plans.

Sustainability initiatives & Accenture Foundation programs.

Diversity & inclusion networks in a globally recognized company.

Flexibility programs (customized schedules, extra vacation days, etc.).



If you are excited about leading AI-driven transformations in supply chain, we’d love to hear from you!

Title: Data Scientist | Central Analytics
Description:
Craft:

Data, Analytics & Strategy

Job Description:

PM Growth Analytics – Data Scientist, Marketing Measurement & Insights

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join Growth Analytics in a hands-on role focused on understanding the true value of Performance Marketing. You will combine experimentation, modelling, and business analysis to evaluate marketing effectiveness, explain performance, and translate findings into clear recommendations that guide investment decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of measurement, analytics, and business decision-making. It is suited to someone with solid analytical foundations, strong commercial curiosity, and the ambition to grow into a Senior Data Scientist. You will take ownership of defined analytical projects, with support from experienced colleagues on more complex methodological and strategic questions, and build increasing independence and influence.

Your work will span incrementality testing, marketing mix modelling (MMM), and understanding why realised returns differ from predictions. You will work closely with buying teams, analysts, and technical partners to connect evidence across measurement approaches and help assess Performance Marketing alongside the wider marketing mix. A sister team focuses on model training infrastructure and production pipelines; your focus will be on analytical rigour, interpretation, and applying findings to business decisions.

Your Role Within Our Kingdom


Connect Measurement to Business Value: You will translate analytical findings into practical recommendations on marketing investment, campaign optimisation, and performance expectations. You will work with stakeholders to connect marketing outcomes to player behaviour and revenue, and follow through to understand whether recommendations improve decisions.
Deliver Marketing Measurement: You will design and analyse incrementality tests and contribute to MMM and other causal analyses, selecting appropriate approaches with guidance where needed. You will own defined projects from the initial business question through analysis, interpretation, and stakeholder readout.
Explain Business Performance: You will investigate where and why ROI is over- or under-predicted, distinguishing changes in player value, campaign mix, measurement assumptions, and underlying business performance. You will help stakeholders understand whether a gap calls for action, further investigation, or more time to gather evidence.
Turn Evidence into Decision Frameworks: You will help translate experiment and model outputs into calibration inputs, performance benchmarks, and repeatable analytical tools. You will bring together evidence from incrementality, attribution, and MMM to support planning and evaluate Performance Marketing within the wider marketing mix.
Bridge Business and Technical Questions: You will work with marketing stakeholders to frame actionable questions and with technical partners to define data and analytical requirements. You will help ensure measurement outputs are interpreted correctly and used effectively in day-to-day decisions.
Communicate Clearly and Improve Our Approach: You will explain findings, assumptions, and uncertainty to technical and non-technical audiences. You will challenge inconsistencies, identify opportunities to improve existing approaches, and take on broader ownership as your expertise develops.


Skills To Create Thrills


Education: Degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: Hands-on experience in data science, analytics, experimentation, or marketing measurement, with examples of taking an analytical question through to a useful business recommendation.
Statistical Foundations: A solid understanding of statistical modelling, hypothesis testing, experimentation, and the distinction between correlation and causation. Practical experience with at least one relevant measurement approach and an interest in developing broader expertise.
Execution: Able to independently deliver well-scoped analytical work, validate results, and manage priorities. Comfortable working through ambiguity while recognising when to seek input or challenge the original question.
Commercial Mindset: Curious about what drives business performance and able to connect analytical results to investment choices, expected returns, and practical actions.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python or R and SQL, with experience working with complex datasets and producing clear, reproducible analyses.
Communication: Able to explain complex findings in accessible language, make recommendations supported by evidence, and communicate uncertainty without losing the practical message.
Judgement and Growth: Thoughtful about assumptions, data quality, and methodological limitations. Receptive to feedback, quick to learn, and ready to develop towards broader project ownership and greater influence over business decisions.


Tasty Bonus Points


Experience working with media buying teams, growth marketing, or other commercial stakeholders.
Familiarity with MMM, GeoLift, holdout testing, synthetic controls, or other causal inference methods.
Experience analysing ROI, lifetime value, forecast accuracy, or the drivers of changes in commercial performance.
Understanding of advertising measurement challenges, including attribution bias, selection effects, organic cannibalisation, and platform limitations.
Exposure to measuring brand or traditional marketing alongside digital Performance Marketing.
Experience turning analysis into repeatable tools or processes used in planning, forecasting, or optimisation.
Familiarity with BigQuery, Looker, or similar data and analytics platforms.
Passion for gaming and curiosity about how player behaviour translates into long-term business value.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

A sister team focuses on model training infrastructure and production pipelines; your focus will be on analytical rigour, interpretation, and applying findings to business decisions.

Your Role Within Our Kingdom

  • Connect Measurement to Business Value: You will translate analytical findings into practical recommendations on marketing investment, campaign optimisation, and performance expectations. You will work with stakeholders to connect marketing outcomes to player behaviour and revenue, and follow through to understand whether recommendations improve decisions.
  • Deliver Marketing Measurement: You will design and analyse incrementality tests and contribute to MMM and other causal analyses, selecting appropriate approaches with guidance where needed. You will own defined projects from the initial business question through analysis, interpretation, and stakeholder readout.
  • Explain Business Performance: You will investigate where and why ROI is over- or under-predicted, distinguishing changes in player value, campaign mix, measurement assumptions, and underlying business performance. You will help stakeholders understand whether a gap calls for action, further investigation, or more time to gather evidence.
  • Turn Evidence into Decision Frameworks: You will help translate experiment and model outputs into calibration inputs, performance benchmarks, and repeatable analytical tools. You will bring together evidence from incrementality, attribution, and MMM to support planning and evaluate Performance Marketing within the wider marketing mix.
  • Bridge Business and Technical Questions: You will work with marketing stakeholders to frame actionable questions and with technical partners to define data and analytical requirements. You will help ensure measurement outputs are interpreted correctly and used effectively in day-to-day decisions.
  • Communicate Clearly and Improve Our Approach: You will explain findings, assumptions, and uncertainty to technical and non-technical audiences. You will challenge inconsistencies, identify opportunities to improve existing approaches, and take on broader ownership as your expertise develops.

Skills To Create Thrills

  • Education: Degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: Hands-on experience in data science, analytics, experimentation, or marketing measurement, with examples of taking an analytical question through to a useful business recommendation.
  • Statistical Foundations: A solid understanding of statistical modelling, hypothesis testing, experimentation, and the distinction between correlation and causation. Practical experience with at least one relevant measurement approach and an interest in developing broader expertise.
  • Execution: Able to independently deliver well-scoped analytical work, validate results, and manage priorities. Comfortable working through ambiguity while recognising when to seek input or challenge the original question.
  • Commercial Mindset: Curious about what drives business performance and able to connect analytical results to investment choices, expected returns, and practical actions.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python or R and SQL, with experience working with complex datasets and producing clear, reproducible analyses.
  • Communication: Able to explain complex findings in accessible language, make recommendations supported by evidence, and communicate uncertainty without losing the practical message.
  • Judgement and Growth: Thoughtful about assumptions, data quality, and methodological limitations. Receptive to feedback, quick to learn, and ready to develop towards broader project ownership and greater influence over business decisions.

Tasty Bonus Points

  • Experience working with media buying teams, growth marketing, or other commercial stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with MMM, GeoLift, holdout testing, synthetic controls, or other causal inference methods.
  • Experience analysing ROI, lifetime value, forecast accuracy, or the drivers of changes in commercial performance.
  • Understanding of advertising measurement challenges, including attribution bias, selection effects, organic cannibalisation, and platform limitations.
  • Exposure to measuring brand or traditional marketing alongside digital Performance Marketing.
  • Experience turning analysis into repeatable tools or processes used in planning, forecasting, or optimisation.
  • Familiarity with BigQuery, Looker, or similar data and analytics platforms.
  • Passion for gaming and curiosity about how player behaviour translates into long-term business value.

About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Title: Data Scientist F/M
Description:
Sixense Satellite, a subsidiary of VINCI Construction, is a leading player in satellite-based ground monitoring. We develop advanced technologies combining remote sensing, InSAR, and data science to deliver high-impact decision-support solutions for infrastructure management, natural hazard monitoring, and land-use planning.

As part of the VINCI Construction group, we help our clients better understand and anticipate ground deformation phenomena through Earth observation data and cutting-edge technologies.

About the Role :

Sixense Satellite is looking for a Data Scientist to join our team and contribute to the development of our Atlas InSAR (Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar) processing chain. You'll work on both maintaining and extending core processing capabilities, and on building new features that push our satellite-based ground deformation monitoring products forward.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of remote sensing, geophysics, and applied machine learning.

What You'll Do :


Contribute to the design, development, and optimization of our InSAR tools and chain
Implement new functionalities and features to expand processing capabilities and product offerings
Design and deploy machine learning models, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), for tasks such as phase unwrapping, atmospheric correction, anomaly/deformation detection, and signal classification
Work with large volumes of SAR and interferometric data, building robust and scalable pipelines
Collaborate closely with geophysicists, radar engineers, and software developers to translate research into production-ready tools
Validate model outputs against ground truth and domain expertise; iterate based on real-world performance
Contribute to technical documentation and internal knowledge sharing


What We're Looking For :


Degree (MSc/PhD) in Data Science, Computer Science, Geophysics, Remote Sensing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
Experience in machine learning, with hands-on expertise in convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Strong Python programming skills; experience with scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, xarray, etc.)
Experience working with geospatial or remote sensing data (SAR/InSAR experience is a strong plus, but not mandatory)
Familiarity with signal/image processing techniques
Comfortable working with large datasets and building production-grade data pipelines
Strong analytical mindset and ability to work independently on open-ended problems
Excellent written and oral reporting skills in English are mandatory.
Good communication skills and ability to work in a multidisciplinary team


Nice to Have :


French or Spanish would be a valued skill.
Prior experience with InSAR, SAR imagery, or satellite remote sensing
Experience with cloud computing platforms and distributed processing
Familiarity with geodesy or ground deformation monitoring


How to Apply ?

Interested candidates are invited to send their CV and a short cover letter to satellite@sixense-group.com with the subject line "Data Scientist – InSAR Processing Chain".

Why Join Us ?


Work on cutting-edge Earth observation technology with real-world impact — infrastructure monitoring, natural hazard detection, mining, and more
Direct influence on the evolution of our core processing chain
Collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment

Title: Data Scientist (Privacy)
Description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

Datavant is looking for an enthusiastic and meticulous Data Scientist (Privacy) to join our growing team, which interrogates and assesses client information in terms of the re-identification risk to patients.

As part of the Privacy Science team within Privacy Solutions you will play a crucial role in ensuring that privacy of patients is safeguarded in the modern world of data sharing. As well as working on real data, you will be involved in exciting research to keep us as industry leaders in this area, and stimulating discussions on re-identification risk. You will be supported in developing/consolidating data analysis and coding skills to become proficient in the analysis of large health-related datasets.

You Will


Critically analyse large health datasets using standard and bespoke software libraries.
Discuss your findings and progress with internal and external stakeholders.
Produce high quality reports which summarise your findings.
Contribute to research activities as we explore novel and established sources of re-identification risk.


What You Will Bring To The Table


MSc or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or similar.
Proficiency with programmable data analysis software Python, and the desire to develop expertise in its language.
A good understanding of statistical probability distributions, bias, error and power as well as sampling and resampling methods.
Seeks to understand real-world data in context rather than consider it in abstraction.
Application of scientific methods to practical problems through experimental design, exploratory data analysis and hypothesis testing to reach robust conclusions.
Strong time management skills and demonstrable experience of prioritising work to meet tight deadlines.
Excellent communication skills. Meticulous attention to detail in the production of comprehensive, well-presented reports.
Initiative and ability to independently explore and research novel topics and concepts as they arise, to expand Privacy Solution’ knowledge base.
An appreciation of the need for effective methods in data privacy and security, and an awareness of the relevant legislation.
Familiarity with Amazon Web Services cloud-based storage and computing facilities.
Bonus: Experience with SQL.
Bonus: Experience of creating documents using LATEX.
Bonus: Detailed knowledge of one or more types of health information such as genomics.
Bonus: Experience with public sector work.


Perks of joining Datavant in Barcelona


25 vacation days
Daily in-office lunch stipend (and a fully stocked kitchen)
Hybrid work model: 2 days/ week in our office in Gracia
Commitment to professional development opportunities
Employee-led initiatives including annual company-wide innovation day & DEI resource groups
Comprehensive private health coverage w/ out-of-network reimbursements options
Flexible remuneration with Cobee (Restaurant, Transportation, Nursery)
Peer & company recognition programs
Monthly educational lunch & learns


To ensure the safety of patients and staff, many of our clients require post-offer health screenings and proof and/or completion of various vaccinations such as the flu shot, Tdap, COVID-19, etc. Any requests to be exempted from these requirements will be reviewed by Datavant Human Resources and determined on a case-by-case basis. Depending on the state in which you will be working, exemptions may be available on the basis of disability, medical contraindications to the vaccine or any of its components, pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions, and/or religion.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

Join our Central Analytics team to build high-quality data marts, tools, and AI-powered workflows that shape player experience and drive game growth. You'll work alongside talented and experienced Analytics Engineers, partnering closely with game and marketing analysts to deliver solutions that make a real difference, all using a modern, cutting-edge technical stack.

To truly make an impact, you'll need to learn quickly, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and collaborate closely within the team and with the stakeholders.

What You’ll Take On


Write and optimize complex SQL queries to support, experimentation, and model feature engineering across large-scale player datasets.
Design, build, and maintain cross-game data marts, providing clean and transformed data ready for Analysts to use.
Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable code, tools, and frameworks that can be adopted across different game teams.
Partner with game analytics teams to co-design, build, and maintain data tools and products used across multiple applications.
Build and maintain end-to-end AI pipelines to support the day to day Analysts tasks.
Share knowledge across the team by educating game analysts on coding and software engineering best practices.


Why should you join us?


We are committed to continuous improvement, you will never stop learning.
We are a collaborative team that learns from each other every day.
We run a large production pipeline spanning ETLs, analytical tools and AI/ML models.
We focus on delivering innovative solutions to real-world problems.


What You Bring


A bachelor degree in a quantitative field (e.g Engineering, Computer Science, Maths, Statistics or Physics).
Advanced SQL skills, including experience with CTEs, query optimization, and large-scale data warehouses.
Advanced experience building and maintaining data pipelines in production environments, using tools such as Airflow, Docker, S3, and CI/CD workflows.
Advanced experience in Python for developing production-level data analytics solutions.
Basic to intermediate experience integrating LLMs or working with generative AI tools and workflows.
A collaborative team player who builds trust, communicates openly, and contributes to shared success.
A fast learner who is proactive and comfortable working with ambiguity.
Detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to accuracy and high-quality outcomes.
Pragmatic, with the ability to balance short-term delivery needs with long-term technical quality.


Nice-to-haves


Experience creating and maintaining dashboards in Tableau or a similar BI tool.
Background in the Mobile Gaming industry.
Background in Marketing Analytics.


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working from home/office system. So, what does this mean? All we ask is that you live within commuting distance of our office in Barcelona so you are able to come into the office for important meetings/events.
Relocation support to help you move to Barcelona (if you’re not already here).
An impressive 25 days annual leave, not including public holidays.
5 additional days annual leave on Christmas.
A very generous ticket-restaurant to restore some life-points.
Private medical insurance for you and your family, to keep your health bar full.
Choose from the latest IOS or Android device upon joining (phone or tablet).
Free language lessons (English & Spanish ).
Spotify Premium to add that special soundtrack that every adventure deserves.
Legendary social events & parties to let off some steam.
Players develop…Oops, sorry! People development is key for us: an amazing budget just for you to spend skilling up your abilities & knowledge to achieve real growth opportunities!


Benefits

Coming to work in the office? Don’t worry - we have you covered. Check out some of our onsite benefits:


Want to stay in shape? We have state of the art gym facilities so you can level up your build stats.

Title: ML Scientist
Description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

We are looking for the first ML research hire on the team. Your job will be to turn our telemetry into new detection and prevention capabilities: from understanding the problem alongside the Security team, to ideating, prototyping, and validating models and algorithms on real data.

We are not looking for someone who applies recipes. We are looking for someone who enjoys tackling an open problem with an adversary that adapts, and who can move comfortably between the paper and the working prototype.

Here Is a Little Taste Of Your Challenge


Work side by side with the Security team to understand current and emerging attack techniques against mobile apps, and translate them into well-framed data problems.
Explore and analyze our telemetry (datalake on ClickHouse and S3) to uncover signals, patterns, and anomalies with detection value.
Design, prototype, and evaluate attack detection and prevention models: anomaly detection, classification with scarce labels, behavioral models, event time-series analysis.
Define how success is measured: detection metrics, acceptable false-positive rates, and evaluation methodology when complete ground truth doesn't exist.
Take validated prototypes toward production in collaboration with the engineering team, and lay the foundations (features, datasets, labeling processes) for the team's ML capability to grow.
Stay current with research in ML applied to security (anomaly detection, adversarial ML, fraud) and bring actionable ideas.


Who are you?


Proven experience (5+ years, or PhD plus applied experience) researching and developing ML models on real-world problems, ideally in security, fraud, anti-bot, anti-malware, or similar adversarial domains.
Strong command of anomaly detection and unsupervised / semi-supervised learning: labeled data is scarce in this domain, and that shapes the entire approach.
Experience with large-scale telemetry or event data: logs, time series, user or device behavior data.
Full autonomy with raw data: solid Python (pandas/polars, scikit-learn, PyTorch or similar), advanced SQL, and comfort working directly against a datalake without prepared datasets.
Product mindset: the ability to go from a research idea to an evaluable prototype in weeks, not months, and to communicate results to non-technical stakeholders.
Genuine curiosity about cybersecurity and the drive to learn the domain in depth alongside the team's experts.


Nice to have


Prior experience in mobile security, EDR, banking anti-fraud, or intrusion detection systems.
Knowledge of adversarial machine learning (model evasion, robustness).
Experience with AWS S3, ClickHouse or other high-volume analytical databases.
Publications, open-source contributions, or talks in applied ML or security.
Experience deploying models to production (basic MLOps).


Practically Speaking, What's In It For You


The chance to define the company's ML strategy from scratch, with direct product impact and full visibility.
A technically fascinating problem: a real adversary that evolves, massive untapped data, and freedom to research.
Daily collaboration with a Security team with deep domain expertise.
Optimized onboarding – for your optimal start and customized induction.
Technical ownership – take responsibility for key components and shape how we build our platform.
Enthusiastic team – waiting to help you succeed and collaborate with experienced engineers.
Beautiful office spaces – in the heart of Barcelona, 200m from Sants Estació with regular team/community events (breakfast, lunch…).
Good transport connections – easy to reach by public transport.
Flexible working hours & Hybrid working!

About BSC

The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.

Look At The BSC Experience

BSC-CNS YouTube Channel

Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!

We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured.

We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.

If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.

Context And Mission

The Barcelona Supercomputing Center’ Data Visualization and Analytics group is looking for a data scientist specialized in AI.

The group has 5 research lines -Industrial Data Science, Urban Data Science, Interactive Data Visualization, Data Storytelling, and Arts+Science Driven Innovation. The goal of this position is to work as data scientist across all of the lines, as most projects include a combination of skills. In particular, to apply AI and advanced statistical methods to problems in advanced manufacturing and factory operation, digital services, energy efficiency, urban planning, digital democracy, as well as science dissemination.

The candidate will join the currently ongoing projects and work with the teams from all the related lines of research. The candidate will also work on procuring funding for future projects.

The funding for these actions/fellowships and contracts comes from the European Union Recovery and Resilience Facility - Next Generation, within the framework of the General Invitation by the public business entity Red.es to participate in the talent attraction and retention programs within Investment 4 of Component 19 of the Recovery, Transformation, and Resilience Plan.

For more information, please check: https://www.bsc.es/join-us/excellence-career-opportunities/ai4s

Key Duties


Data exploration and preparation.
Talking to end users and domain experts to capture the key components of a problem.
Exploratory modeling (architecture design, pipeline design).
Visualization and presentation of preliminary results.
Advise younger researchers and engineers in the group.
Help write reports, deliverables, and research proposals.


Requirements


Education
Masters or PhD Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or technoogy related field.
Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
Experience with AI and advanced statistical models applied to science and industry
Experience working on applied data science projects.
Strong AI programming experience, preferably in Python
Strong initiative to carry on research and development independently.
Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
Fluency in English is essential. Proficiency in Spanish and other European languages would be advantageous.
Experience on some of the application fields of the group’s projects
Competences
Ability to work in a team and in a multi-cultural environment.
Excellent communication skills, especially for producing documentation (reports, manuals, papers).

Conditions


The position will be located at BSC within the CASE Department
We offer a full-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance
Duration: until 31/12/2028
Holidays: 22 days of holidays + 6 personal days + 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
Salary: 45.00,00€
Additional Expenses Grant: Each fellowship will be associated with a grant for additional expenses, such as IT equipment, travel, training, stays, etc.
Starting date: asap


Applications procedure and process

All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:


A full CV in English, including contact details.
A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.


Development of the recruitment process

The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:


Curriculum Analysis: Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. - 40 points
Interview phase: The highest-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. - 60 points. A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.


The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

In accordance with OTM-R principles, a gender-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile.

At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment@bsc.es.

For more information, please follow this link.

Deadline

The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.

OTM-R principles for selection processes

BSC-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment principles (OTM-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.

BSC-CNS is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable state or local law.

For more information follow this link

This position is reserved for candidates who meet the requirements and have the legal status of disabled persons with a degree of disability equal to or greater than 33%. In case there are no applicants with disabilities that meet the requirements, the rest of the candidates without declared disability will be evaluated.

Title: AI Engineer / Data Scientist
Description:
En Veltech buscamos un/a AI Engineer / Data Scientist con una sólida base en data, Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial, que quiera trabajar en el desarrollo de soluciones avanzadas basadas en IA generativa, LLMs y agentes inteligentes.

Buscamos un perfil técnico, con capacidad para entender problemas complejos, seleccionar y desarrollar los algoritmos adecuados y llevar soluciones de IA desde la experimentación hasta su implementación.

Responsabilidades


Desarrollo de soluciones de Advanced Analytics: Construcción y despliegue de soluciones basadas en Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Inteligencia Artificial.
Generative AI: Desarrollo e integración de soluciones basadas en LLMs, incluyendo prompting, embeddings, RAG y otros patrones de aplicación de IA generativa.
AI Agents: Diseño y desarrollo de agentes inteligentes capaces de utilizar herramientas, razonar sobre tareas y ejecutar flujos de trabajo de forma autónoma o semiautónoma.
Experimentación y evaluación: Evaluación de modelos y soluciones mediante métricas adecuadas, experimentación iterativa y análisis de resultados.
Data & Engineering: Preparación y transformación de datos, integración con diferentes fuentes y desarrollo de componentes necesarios para llevar los modelos a entornos productivos.
Optimización: Análisis y mejora del rendimiento, precisión y eficiencia de los modelos y soluciones desarrolladas.
Colaboración: Trabajo conjunto con perfiles de Data, Software y negocio para transformar necesidades reales en soluciones basadas en IA.


Requisitos mínimos


Experiencia profesional en Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering o campos relacionados.
Algoritmia: Sólida base en algoritmos, estructuras de datos, modelado y resolución de problemas.
Programación: Dominio de Python y experiencia trabajando con librerías y frameworks de Machine Learning/IA.
Machine Learning: Conocimientos sólidos de modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, así como de técnicas de entrenamiento, evaluación y optimización.
Generative AI: Conocimientos o experiencia práctica con LLMs, prompting, embeddings, RAG y/o arquitecturas basadas en IA generativa.
AI Agents: Interés o experiencia en el desarrollo de agentes de IA, tool calling, MCP, workflows/agentes autónomos o frameworks relacionados.
Datos: Buen manejo de SQL y experiencia trabajando con datos para el desarrollo y evaluación de modelos.
Producción: Capacidad para transformar prototipos y experimentos en soluciones robustas y mantenibles.


Se valorará


Experiencia desarrollando soluciones de Advanced Analytics, Generative AI y AI Agents en entornos reales.
Experiencia con frameworks de agentes y LLMs como LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex u otros similares.
Conocimientos de arquitecturas RAG, vector & graph databases y sistemas de búsqueda semántica.
Experiencia con APIs de modelos como OpenAI, Anthropic u otros proveedores.
Experiencia con Cloud, especialmente Azure.
Conocimientos de MLOps, CI/CD, Docker o herramientas de despliegue.
Experiencia previa en proyectos de forecasting, optimización o algoritmia aplicada.
Experiencia en la industria de aerolíneas.
