Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¡Hola! Somos OGA




Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo.




Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico.




Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.




Sobre la posición.




Buscamos un/a Data Scientist con experiencia en la investigación, análisis y modelado de datos para identificar patrones y tendencias clave, impulsando la toma de decisiones estratégicas en la organización, para unirse a nuestro equipo.




¿Qué harás?





Análisis de datos y desarrollo de aplicaciones de optimización de procesos complejos con técnicas tanto de Inteligencia Artificial como de Investigación Operativa, utilizando entre otros, lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, JavaScript o C++.


Analizar, depurar, transformar, visualizar, etc. los datos disponibles para proyectos de IA, utilizando las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias en cada caso concreto.


Realizar el EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) de los datos para proporcionar un buen conjunto de datos a los modelos de IA.


Utilización de diferentes modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, los cuales serán entrenados, validados y testados en función de los objetivos de cada proyecto.


Tuning de modelos ML/DL.


Investigación e implementación de algoritmos y herramientas de ML/DL.


Implementación del pipeline completo de un modelo de ML/DL (Datasource, Limpieza datos, Ingeniería de Variables, Entrenamientos, Validación, Puesta en producción y Monitorización/Operación).


Analizarás bases de datos utilizando técnicas de análisis estadístico avanzado.


Desarrollarás soluciones y modelos avanzados de Inteligencia Artificial.


Elaborarás documentación técnica relacionada con los proyectos.









Timing de primeras semanas en OGA




Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.




¿Qué requerimos?





Titulación en Máster en Matemáticas / Estadística / Ingeniería / Ciencias de la Computación o área relacionada (valorable Doctorado).


Experiencia de 3 a 5 años en el sector de Inteligencia Artificial, incluyendo al menos 2 años como consultor liderando proyectos complejos y horizontales con exposición al negocio, con experiencia en tratamiento de datos (captura, almacenamiento, normalización, limpieza, visualización, ETLs y modelos de datos) e implementación de soluciones de IA utilizando Machine Learning y Deep Learning, aplicando algoritmos supervisados, no supervisados y auto-explicativos, como RandomForest, CatBoost, XGBoost, CNN y RNN.


Conocimiento y dominio experto en Python (valorable experiencia en otras plataformas y lenguajes), conocimientos recomendables en bases de datos como Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL y MS SQL/SQL Azure, así como experiencia en el entorno de desarrollo de Microsoft Azure. Nivel Alto de inglés.









¿Qué valoramos?





Airflow, Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB.


Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especiación tecnológica.


Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente.


Capacidad de relación con equipos de negocio y funcionales, visión holística del problema de negocio a resolver.


Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo.


Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional de manera esporádica.









¿Qué te ofrecemos?





Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.


Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.


Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.


Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.


Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.


Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.


Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.


Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.


Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.


Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.









¡Únete a nosotros!




Si te entusiasma nuestra visión innovadora y estás listo/a para enfrentar desafíos diarios con empresas líderes, ¡queremos conocerte! Aplica ahora y únete a OGA para seguir creando soluciones increíbles y de gran impacto.




Por supuesto, si durante el proceso de selección necesitaras algún tipo de asistencia, simplemente avísanos. Nuestro equipo de People te ayudará para asegurarnos de que todo vaya sobre ruedas y tengas una experiencia genial.




¡Te esperamos!

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Commerce Analytics & Insights
Description:
What You'll Do:

We are looking for a senior, strategic, and hands-on Data Scientist to lead the data and methodological backbone of Commerce Analytics and Commerce Insights at Criteo. This person will own the analytical rigor behind the work: building and improving pipelines, understanding source tables and data dependencies, ensuring reliable execution, and defining or validating the methodologies behind key metrics and outputs.

This role is not only about producing analyses. It is about creating trusted, scalable analytical foundations for Commerce Analytics and Insights, while staying close enough to business context to ensure the work remains relevant and useful.

Success in this role means pipelines and analytical workflows are reliable, maintainable, and trusted; metrics are clearly defined, methodologically sound, and consistently applied; and analytical outputs are accurate and resilient enough for repeated commercial use. Data dependencies, assumptions, and limitations should be documented and understood, while manual analytical work should decrease over time as scalable solutions are introduced.

This role is not the primary owner of client orchestration or commercial project leadership. Its center of gravity is data execution, methodological rigor, and scalable analytical foundations.

What You'll Do


Own the data-science and analytical execution layer of Commerce Analytics and Commerce Insights
Build, improve, and maintain data pipelines that power recurring analytics and insightgeneration
Develop deep understanding of source tables, data lineage, business logic, and data qualityrisks
Ensure analytical outputs are correct, consistent, and operationally reliable
Define, document, challenge, and improve methodologies behind key metrics, cuts, andanalytical frameworks
Partner with Solution Architect and commercial stakeholders to translate business questionsinto robust analytical approaches
Drive the hands-on execution of analyses across commerce analytics and commerce insightsuse cases
Create scalable approaches rather than one-off manual work whenever possible
Investigate data issues, edge cases, or inconsistencies and resolve them with strongownership
Contribute to documentation, process improvement, and knowledge transfer so that work canscale beyond one individual
Help identify where automation, standardization, or better data design can improve quality and speed
Stay close to business context so that technical execution remains aligned with client and program needs



Who You Are:


Senior and hands-on, with strong ownership of both execution and quality
Deeply comfortable with data engineering and pipelines, analytical logic, and metric design
Strong SQL, Python, spark and strong coding skills for data processing and workflowdevelopment
Experience building production-grade or near-production analytical pipelines
Experience documenting methods and educating stakeholders on metric definitions and analytical caveats is a plus
Able to understand what tables mean, how they connect, and where business interpretation can go wrong
Methodologically rigorous, with strong judgment on how to define and validate metrics
Structured and practical: you can move from ambiguous business questions to executable analytical solutions
Comfortable collaborating with client-facing and non-technical stakeholders, even if this is not the center of gravity of the role
Strategic enough to improve the system, not just execute within it
Significant experience in data science, analytics engineering, analytical product work, or a similar role in a data-rich environment
Strong understanding of experimentation, metrics, methodology design, and analytical QA
Experience working with large-scale behavioral, commerce, or media datasets



We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.

📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.

💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.

🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.

💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

Title: Data Scientist - (Hybrid)
Description:
Data Scientist (They/She/He) - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Data Scientist to join our Data Science Team in Barcelona. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there. You will have the opportunity to either crunch massive datasets using the latest Big Data technologies or solve a quick problem with an already classic algorithm. We always promote using the best tool for each task. You will be a key player in the organization by designing and implementing advanced analytics and using machine learning to build AI-powered solutions for almost every area in the business like online fraud detection, recommendation engines, user experience personalization, optimizing the flight combinations we offer or the marketing campaigns we launch, and virtually every possible area subject to optimization in the business etc. Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

Our dynamic team of young, talented professionals from over 60 different nationalities is driven by one clear mission: making travel easier, more accessible, and create better value for our 18 million customers worldwide. Inside our Data Science team, we research and build cutting-edge solutions to be able to offer more and better combinations of tailored travel plans than any other site. We have dozens of machine learning models in production doing hundreds of thousands of predictions that optimize our processes, improve the content for our customers and help us adapt to changes in the market. The team is constantly analyzing the past to understand it, and predicting the future to guide business on making the decisions that drive the most value both for our customers and our business.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – 7M members in Prime

More than 100 million searches per day - Up to 6 billion daily AI predictions[e1]

Over 1,600 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts - 36 average age

We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Data Scientist in the Data Science team you will be in charge of:


Conduct predictive analytics to better understand how our customers interact with our products and help us anticipate their needs.
Collaborate with Product and Business teams in order to embed Machine Learning into our apps, services and products and create predictive models and generate insights from our data.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning technologies and Data Science trends.
Effectively communicate results and insights with other stakeholders throughout the organization.



What you need to succeed:

Job Requirements

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or other quantitative fields).
2+ years of related experience as a Data Scientist, Machine Learning engineer or similar.
Previous experience in problem-solving, strong analytical and technical skills.
You have a solid understanding of appropriate statistical, data mining and machine learning methods for various analysis situations.
Strong experience coding in Python. Other programming languages like Scala, R, or Java are also valued.
Experience using frameworks like, Spark, Tensorflow and the already classic libraries like scikit-learn, pandas, etc.
Solid knowledge and use of SQL is important. Experience in Big Data technologies; such as distributed computing, NoSQL/graph databases or architectures based on Kubernetes, airflow or Kafka would be a plus.
You are committed to following good practices and conventions, from code versioning to QA processes and monitorization.
Written and oral communication skills (in English).



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Smadex is a leading advertising technology company founded in Barcelona in 2011 and sold to American-based and stock-listed Entravision in 2018 (NYSE::EVC). We are a fully transparent platform built with top technology, countless programmatic management features and powerful machine learning algorithms to help advertisers grow their business at scale. We are currently considered one of the top mobile ad-tech companies in the world.




As a Senior Data Scientist, you won’t just analyze data, you will actively shape the future of our mobile advertising platform. You will sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and business, transforming raw behavioral data from millions of global users into scalable strategies. We are looking for a high-caliber professional who thrives in ambiguity, sets high analytical standards, and translates complex insights into product decisions.




This is a full-time position based in Barcelona.




Product & ML Strategy Influence

Own the analytical loop that influences our Product and Machine Learning strategies. Use data to identify untapped opportunities and define what we build next.
Design, execute, and evaluate sophisticated experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, multivariate testing) to measure the impact of new product features and ML algorithms.
Establish and govern key performance frameworks to align cross-functional teams on what success looks like.




Scalable Analytics & Frameworks

Build reproducible data models, frameworks, and processes that allow the company to scale decision-making without reinventing the wheel.
Design high-impact data visualization assets that democratize data access and enable self-service insights for both technical and commercial stakeholders.




Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as the strategic data partner for engineering, product, and business teams, translating deep technical findings into actionable, high-level business recommendations.
Raise the bar for analytical rigor across the organization, mentoring junior team members and establishing best practices.




Skills & Requirements

Experience: 5+ years of proven experience as a Data Scientist or Product Analyst, preferably in high-growth tech environments or mobile ecosystems.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a highly quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Economics).
Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience working with massive, complex datasets and modern cloud data warehouses
Statistical Rigor: Solid understanding of statistical concepts, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and regression methodologies.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to present complex technical conclusions to C-level executives and non-technical stakeholders with clarity and impact.

Strong background in the ad-tech industry, mobile programmatic advertising (DSP/SSP), or user acquisition (UA) dynamics.
Familiarity with mobile app measurement frameworks (MMPs) and concepts like LTV optimization or incrementality.
Experience working with global, distributed cross-functional teams.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics
Description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Madrid

Compensation: €95,000 - €115,000 / year

Description

Location: Madrid, Spain

Annual Remuneration: €95,000 - €115,000 and discretionary annual bonus

Pay Frequency: Monthly

Probationary Period: 180 days

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3-days per week

TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics based in Madrid.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:


Taking ownership of Kharon's risk propagation and entity analytics system — the engine that evaluates entities in our knowledge graph and surfaces meaningful risk signals to customers
Designing and implementing complex analytical logic that translate nuanced geopolitical and financial risk into structured, interpretable outputs
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and graph-based ML systems that power risk scoring and entity analysis
Partnering closely with Research, Product, and Engineering teams to understand evolving risk frameworks and translate them into robust, maintainable systems
Iterating on the system's architecture to increase the complexity and precision it can handle — this is not a rip-and-replace, but a thoughtful evolution of a system already in production
Exploring how LLMs and other AI techniques can be integrated to handle increasingly complex risk logic


Qualifications


A proven interest or experience in global security, financial crimes, sanctions, export controls, or related domains
4+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, with demonstrated ownership of production systems
Strong foundation in statistics and the ability to apply quantitative methods to complex, real-world problems
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and working with graph databases or knowledge graph structures
Experience with graph analysis, graph ML, or network analysis — professional experience is a strong differentiator
Comfort working across research and data engineering contexts — this role spans all three
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and API development
Strong product instincts — able to go deep technically while staying aligned to customer and business outcomes
Bonus: Experience with LLMs or AI-assisted analytical systems


About Kharon

Kharon operates at the nexus of global security and is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible.

From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

Disclosures

Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

If you require any adjustment to participate in the recruitment process, please contact apply@kharon.com. You must have the right to work in Europe and Spain. Kharon is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that Kharon will process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation and Spanish data protection legislation. For information about how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice at www.kharon.com/privacy. You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data, to object to or restrict its processing, and to lodge a complaint with the Spanish data protection authority, the AEPD, at www.aepd.es. To exercise your rights, contact us at apply@kharon.com.

If your application is unsuccessful, your data will be retained for up to 12 months before being securely deleted. If you accept a role, your data will transfer to your employee record.

Title: Lead Data Scientist
Description:
Overview

The next great shift in consumer behavior driven by technological disruption is underway, and it’s happening in the food & beverage industry. As other sectors have shifted to Digital Commerce-first business models in recent years, food & beverage has continued to rely predominantly on traditional brick & mortar models, but this is changing rapidly. New technologies are transforming every aspect of reaching consumers, from the rise of digital marketing and online grocery platforms to the creation of supply chain tools that enable speedy at-home delivery.

Although PepsiCo is a large multinational, the PepsiCo Global Digital Commerce Team prides itself on having the entrepreneurial, action-oriented culture of an exciting startup business. Our group includes startup founders, Silicon Valley veterans, food & beverage experts, and seasoned executives from digital transformation leaders such as Amazon and Walmart. Our goal is to build the technological products and capabilities that will reinvent our industry and make us the #1 food & beverage business in Digital Commerce for decades to come.

To deepen our efforts to seize this opportunity and lead the food & beverage industry into its remarkable next chapter, PepsiCo – a global company with powerhouse brands including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker, and Tropicana – is expanding its Global Digital Commerce Team to power International Growth. We’re looking for the greatest minds in data & analytics, data engineering, software development, machine learning optimization and more. All with the aim to empower out International expansion and delight our consumers through addressing of current and future facing butsiness challenges that are complex and require insightful and impactful solutions.

We are looking for seasoned data scientist to join our team as we continue to grow our capability footprint across regions.The DS will be part of a collaborative interdisciplinary team around data, where will be responsible of building deployable statistical/machine learning models, starting from the discovery phase. DS will work closely with process owners, product owners and final business users.

Responsibilities


Contribute to best practices for engineering, and coding as part of a world class engineering team in PepsiCo.
Work with the product team leveraging our core technology platforms
Active contributor to code development in projects and services
Act as contributor in innovation activities
Partner with data engineers to ensure data access for discovery and proper data is prepared for model consumption.
Partner with DS and ML engineers working on industrialization.
Occasionally, coordinate work activities with Business teams, other IT services and as required.
Communicate with business stakeholders in the process of service design, training and knowledge transfer.
Support large-scale experimentation and build data-driven models.
Set KPIs and metrics to evaluate analytics solution given a particular use case.
Refine requirements into modelling problems.
Influence product teams through data-based recommendations.
Research in state-of-the-art methodologies.
Create documentation for learnings and knowledge transfer.
Create reusable packages or libraries.


Qualifications


4+ years working in a team to deliver production level analytic solutions. Fluent in git (version control). Understanding of Jenkins, Docker are a plus.
4+ years’ experience in ETL and/or data wrangling techniques. Fluent in SQL syntaxis.
4+ years’ experience in Statistical/ML techniques to solve supervised (regression, classification) and unsupervised problems. Experiences with Deep Learning are a plus.
4+ years’ experience in developing business problem related statistical/ML modeling with industry tools with primary focus on Python or Scala development.
Expertise in creating models that captures the impact of input drivers on KPIS
Business storytelling and communicating data insights in business consumable format. Fluent in one Visualization tool.
Strong communications and organizational skills with the ability to deal with ambiguity while juggling multiple priorities
Experience with Agile methodology for team work and analytics ‘product’ creation. Fluent in Jira, Confluence.
Experience in Simulation and Optimization problems in any space is a plus.
Experience with Responsible AI is a plus.
Experience with distributed machine learning is a plus
Experience in Retail, E-commerce or Financial Services domain is preferred.
Very strong analytical skills with the demonstrated ability to research and make decisions based on the day-to-day and complex customer problems required
Hands on experience of handling large data sets and use of python/PySpark/SQL/Hive/Impala for data analysis
Strong record of achievement, solid analytical ability, and an entrepreneurial hands-on approach to work.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills


What makes us different?


Hybrid work model: combination of remote and collaborative office experience to enable innovation
Entrepreneurial environment in leading international company
Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities
Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing
Volunteering opportunities to help external communities


About PepsiCo

We believe that culture should be at the cornerstone of everything we do at PepsiCo. We are agile, innovative and not afraid of failure. We want our team to come to work every day excited to explore new ways to bring enjoyment, refreshment and fun to the world.

PepsiCo Positive (pep+) is the future of our organization – a strategic end-to-end transformation, with sustainability at the center of how we will create growth and value by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for the planet and people.

So, if you’re ready to be a part of a playground for those who think big, we’d love to chat.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do


Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;
Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;
Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;
Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


Nice-to-Have


Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;
Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;
Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.


€38,000 - €75,000 a year

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €38k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Científico de datos
Description:
Únete a Amaris Consulting y participa en proyectos estratégicos de ciencia de datos para una empresa del sector retail. Trabajarás con equipos multidisciplinares, en un entorno ágil donde podrás asumir responsabilidades, aportar ideas y seguir desarrollando tu carrera profesional.




🎯 Tu misión y tu impacto

Como Senior Data Scientist, serás responsable de llevar modelos de Machine Learning e IA Generativa desde la fase de experimentación hasta su despliegue en producción, garantizando código limpio, automatización y rigor en la evaluación. Trabajarás junto a equipos de tecnología y negocio para construir sistemas que predigan de forma eficiente en entornos reales y soluciones de IA que respondan basándose en datos corporativos fiables.

Tu experiencia combinando Machine Learning clásico con el estado del arte de la IA Generativa, junto con tu capacidad de liderazgo, será clave para el éxito de los proyectos.




✅ Lo que buscamos

Más de 5 años de experiencia como Data Scientist, ML Engineer o en un puesto similar.
Aplicación avanzada y despliegue de modelos supervisados (p. ej. Random Forest) y no supervisados (p. ej. K-Means).
Dominio de técnicas de validación como la validación cruzada y experiencia con métricas de evaluación especializadas, más allá del accuracy.
Experiencia en feature engineering avanzado y en el tratamiento de conjuntos de datos altamente desbalanceados.
Dominio de Python y Scikit-Learn para construir pipelines estructurados, limpios y modulares.
Noción sólida de arquitectura de software para empaquetar modelos, automatizar su entrenamiento y asegurar su escalabilidad en producción. Excluyente el perfil puramente “de notebook”.
Experiencia demostrable configurando LLMs con function calling y uso de herramientas, garantizando salidas estructuradas (p. ej. JSON).
Dominio de frameworks como LangChain o LlamaIndex para construir flujos conversacionales, de razonamiento y agentes autónomos.
Conocimiento profundo de embeddings, bases de datos vectoriales y calibración de hiperparámetros (p. ej. temperatura).
Experiencia implementando arquitecturas RAG: chunking semántico, solapamiento y búsqueda semántica.
Conocimiento práctico de librerías y métricas de evaluación de LLMs (LLM-as-a-judge, RAGAS o similares).

🛠 Lo que harás

Machine Learning tradicional y predicción

Desarrollar y desplegar modelos predictivos que vayan más allá del análisis de datos históricos y funcionen de forma eficiente en entornos reales.
Validar los modelos con rigor para asegurar su rendimiento en producción y evitar el sobreajuste.
Evaluar los modelos con múltiples métricas especializadas.
Crear nuevas variables significativas y transformar y enriquecer los datos para maximizar la capacidad de aprendizaje de los algoritmos.
Construir pipelines de código en Python, empaquetar modelos y automatizar su entrenamiento, asegurando su escalabilidad y robustez en producción.

IA Generativa y LLMs

Configurar LLMs como motores de razonamiento que consumen herramientas externas, como consultas a bases de datos SQL/NoSQL o integración con APIs internas.
Garantizar que los modelos devuelvan estructuras de datos precisas (como JSON) para la ejecución orquestada de acciones.
Construir flujos conversacionales, de razonamiento y agentes autónomos complejos.
Generar y gestionar embeddings, desplegar bases de datos vectoriales y calibrar hiperparámetros para equilibrar determinismo y creatividad.
Implementar arquitecturas RAG que conecten la documentación y las bases de conocimiento de la empresa con los modelos, para que la IA responda basándose estrictamente en datos corporativos reales.
Auditar mediante código la fiabilidad de las respuestas, detectar alucinaciones y validar la correcta ejecución del tool use.

🧠 Tu mindset y soft skills

Capacidad de liderazgo y de orientar técnicamente a otros perfiles.
Pensamiento analítico y orientación a la resolución de problemas.
Rigor y atención a la calidad en todo el ciclo de vida de los modelos.
Comunicación clara con perfiles técnicos y de negocio.
Actitud colaborativa y capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
Autonomía, responsabilidad y orientación a resultados.
Curiosidad e interés por la evolución constante de la IA.

✨ Se valorará especialmente

Experiencia en proyectos del sector retail.
Nivel de inglés profesional.

🚀 ¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?

Crecimiento profesional: el 70 % de nuestros líderes senior comenzaron en posiciones junior.
Formación continua: acceso a nuestra Technology Academy, cursos en Udemy, webinars y certificaciones financiadas por la compañía.
Flexibilidad: opciones de trabajo en remoto, políticas de trabajo flexible y beneficios sociales, como tickets restaurante, transporte, ayuda guardería y seguro médico privado.
Bienestar: nuestro programa WeCare acompaña a los empleados en situaciones críticas.
Desarrollo personal: presupuesto anual de formación para potenciar tanto las habilidades técnicas como las competencias profesionales.

En Amaris Consulting, estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno inclusivo. Damos la bienvenida a todas las candidaturas cualificadas, independientemente de su género, orientación sexual, raza, etnia, edad o cualquier otra característica.

Description:
Desde LHH Recruitment Solutions seguimos colaborando con una prestigiosa empresa del sector seguros, en pleno proceso de Transformación con el objetivo de posicionarse como la compañía referente dentro del sector seguros. Como parte de este ambicioso reto, actualmente buscamos un/a:




Data Scientist




MISIÓN

Únete a la transformación de Santa Lucía y marca la diferencia resolviendo retos reales de negocio con datos e impacto directo en el cliente y en los resultados de la compañía.







RESPONSABILIDADES DEL PUESTO

Colaborar con los responsables de su propia unidad y con el resto de las áreas de negocio y técnicas en la definición y desarrollo de proyectos analíticos, de Machine Learning y de IA, incluyendo IA generativa, asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos y expectativas, supervisando los entregables comprometidos e informando de avances, bloqueos y riesgos potenciales de forma proactiva.
Trabajar de la mano con las distintas áreas del Grupo Santalucía y la Red Agencial para entender en profundidad los problemas de negocio, aplicando escucha activa y teniendo en cuenta las particularidades de cada unidad en la definición de soluciones basadas en datos e IA.
Analizar la información existente y proponer nuevas aproximaciones que permitan enriquecerla, incluyendo el uso de datos estructurados y no estructurados, con el objetivo de resolver retos de negocio mediante soluciones analíticas y de IA tradicional y generativa.
Diseñar, evaluar y evolucionar soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas a casos de uso reales, asegurando su alineación con los objetivos de negocio y con los estándares técnicos del grupo.
Definir cuándo utilizar modelos de IA generativa frente a modelos de machine learning tradicionales, reglas u otros enfoques analíticos, aplicando criterio técnico y de negocio.
Diseñar y mantener soluciones de IA integradas con datos corporativos, así como definir diferentes métricas de utilidad para el negocio, y para el equipo de Data Science.
Promover el uso responsable y controlado de los datos y de la IA dentro de la compañía, conforme a las políticas internas de seguridad, privacidad, cumplimiento y a los estándares de calidad y legalidad establecidos.
Aportar capacidades de tratamiento y preparación del dato cuando sea necesario, como soporte a soluciones analíticas y de IA, garantizando la calidad de la información utilizada.

Title: Data Scientist - Pricing
Description:
About Us

At Munich Re Specialty – Global Markets (MRS-GM), it is our ambition to become the leading Primary Specialty Insurance provider, underpinned by an effective and adaptable strategy, superior products and industry leaders working in a supportive environment to achieve this.

At the heart of our success is a strong culture where people are encouraged to be present, bold and curious, allowing them to achieve their individual goals.

Please see our website for more information.

Data Scientist – Pricing

We are currently looking for a Data Scientist - Pricing to be based in Madrid on a full-time basis, reporting into the European HUB Pricing Manager.

You will be responsible for supporting the Pricing function’s evolution into a data-driven function within the Global Markets Pricing team in Madrid, applying data science and database techniques to pricing data and driving process automation to improve forecasting, decision-making, reporting and operational efficiency.

You will help collect, organise and analyse pricing and underwriting data from various sources, build well-structured databases, and develop predictive and analytical models and dashboards that clearly communicate insights to stakeholders.

You will collaborate closely with the underwriting team supporting the Chief of Underwriting, the Country Heads and the London and Munich Actuarial teams.

Responsibilities


Develop Power BI dashboards and reports that clearly communicate insights to stakeholders.
Collect, organise and analyse pricing and underwriting data from various sources across the Pricing team to derive insights that inform business decisions.
Build predictive and analytical models to identify key pricing and rating risk factors, improving forecasting and decision-making accuracy.
Design, build and maintain well-structured databases to support scalable pricing tools.
Support the build and maintenance of rating engine structures and underlying databases in HX Renew and other pricing platforms.
Collaborate closely with the Pricing team to identify areas where data-driven insights and automation can improve their operations.
Work with the IT team to ensure that pricing data is stored and analysed securely, with sound database design and management.
Maintain clear documentation of data sources, processes and models to support audit, governance and knowledge-sharing.
Help drive forward good Conduct for the business to deliver the best outcomes for customers / policyholders.



Knowledge And Skills


At least 3 years of experience in a data science, data analytics or database-focused role, preferably within the insurance industry.
Strong knowledge of databases and SQL, with practical experience designing, building and querying relational databases.
Working knowledge of Power BI; experience with Databricks or similar big data platforms is a plus.
Experience building predictive and analytical models to support business decision-making.
Solid understanding of, or strong interest in, pricing/actuarial processes and data.
Strong business acumen and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and analysis into clear, actionable insights for both technical and business stakeholders.
Experience with HX Renew or similar pricing platforms, and exposure to data governance or data quality practices, is a plus.
Fluency in English is a must, other European languages are also an advantage.



If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with everything outlined, or you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the candidate we are looking for!

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Munich Re, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion foster innovation and resilience and enable us to act braver and better. Embracing the power of DEI is at the core of who we are. We recognise diversity can be multi-dimensional, intersectional, and complex, so we want to build a diverse workforce that includes a wide range of racial, ethnic, sexual, and gender identities; economic and geographic backgrounds; physical abilities; ages; life, school, and career experiences; and political, religious, and personal beliefs. Additionally, we are committed to building an equitable and inclusive work environment where this diversity is celebrated, valued, and has equitable opportunities to succeed.

All candidates in consideration for any role can request a reasonable adjustment at any point in our recruitment process. You can request an adjustment by speaking to your Talent Acquisition contact.

Learning and innovating today, striving for sustainable societies and business tomorrow

At Munich Re Specialty – Global Markets our approach to ESG is underpinned by our desire to seize business opportunities and to nurture a stimulating and inclusive work environment. Our ESG strategy aims to deliver holistic impacts across environmental, social and governance topics including supporting a number of local initiatives within our community and offering volunteering opportunities for colleagues.

Learn more about sustainability at Munich Re – choose your impact!

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Senior Data Scientist. In this role you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world - creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don't just come here to work, they come here to grow - solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:


Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably


Overview:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive modelling to join our growing team. As Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for driving the construction of predictive models to solve business problems, communicate to the technical team, and assure the delivery matches business expectations. You will also be responsible for working with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities:


Design, create, test, and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions throughout the organization.
Gives technical support for data scientists across multiple squads.
Collaborate with business analysts and understand business problems to implement scalable and sustainable solutions.
Define development standards and solution approach.
Design and structure reusable codebase
Coordinate with Digital Specialists, and Data Engineers and other Data Scientists to deliver holistic analytical solutions
Communicates the design, functioning and output of the analytical models/solutions developed
Ensure timely analysis and testing for regular maintenance of solutions over time
Communicate data insights to stakeholders.


What You Bring:


PhD in STEM field with research experience in Data Science or experience Post graduate degree in STEM field with 3-5 years' experience as Lead Data Scientist or Senior Data Scientist
Expert in programming languages like Python or R
Advanced knowledge in math, analytics and computer science, knowledge of machine learning methods, statistical models, advanced data science programming.
Proficient in data science, optimization, machine learning, Python, R, SQL, data analysis, analytical skills, teamwork, and communication skills.
Can help business structure the problems/hypotheses they want to address and convert it into an advanced analytics approach including machine learning and optimization components (e.g., Constraints, penalties, and objective function
Solid experience working with models developed on Cloud environments: GCP, Azure, AWS preferred
Develop business awareness of possible use cases and help them to understand the necessary concepts of data science and optimization to ensure better communication across functions.
Avoid greenhorn mistakes, avoid logical flaws in the models, revisit high-performing systems, write reusable code, build resilient data pipelines in the cloud environment, and prepare immaculate data.
Make decisions aligned to Bunge’s global strategy, business needs and financial goals and explore new perspectives by driving innovation.
Cultivate strong relationships and networks, effectively influence others, and develop talent to excel in their current and future roles.
Develop data driven strategies aligned with Bunge’s priorities, energize others to action through clear and compelling communication.

We are a world leader in grain origination, storage, distribution, oilseed processing and refining, offering a broad portfolio of plant-based oils, fats, and proteins. We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. With 200+ years of experience and presence in over 50 countries, we are committed to strengthening global food security, advancing sustainability, and helping communities prosper where we operate. Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Forma parte de una compañía puntera en el sector seguros

Aplicamos tecnología de vanguadia en el sector seguros. Crece con nosotros y lidera proyectos pioneros en este sector.

Algunas de las funciones más específicas

Comprender las necesidades de las líneas de negocio y saber cómo traducirlas en términos de análisis de datos y modelos cuantitativos de Analítica Avanzada e Inteligencia Artificial

Desarrollar el conocimiento de los datos recopilados y su estructura, así como de los sistemas en los que están contenidos hasta donde sea preciso para la realización con éxito de su actividad.

En agap2 estamos buscando un/a Senior Data Scientist para unirse a nuestro equipo y participar en proyectos clave de innovación tecnológica. Si te apasiona la IA, el aprendizaje automático y quieres formar parte de una consultora internacional en pleno crecimiento,

¡este proyecto es para ti!




Como Senior Data Scientist, contribuirás activamente en la investigación, definición, prototipado, desarrollo y puesta en producción de soluciones avanzadas basadas en algorítmica de Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning.




Funciones:

Entenderás las necesidades y retos analíticos de los diferentes departamentos (planificación, compras, distribución, etc.).
Desarrollarás pruebas de concepto (PoC) rápidas con herramientas como Streamlit, evaluando la calidad y potencial de los datos disponibles y preparando proyectos futuros con métricas de ROI asociadas.
Desarrollarás y escalarás proyectos basados en algoritmos de Machine Learning en entornos de producción.
Colaborarás mano a mano con otros Data Scientists, ML Engineers y miembros del equipo de Advanced Analytics para asegurar la óptima implementación de las soluciones.
Utilizarás tecnologías Big Data para gestionar grandes volúmenes de datos y optimizar la eficiencia y rendimiento de los modelos.




Requisitos:

Formación: Grado o Máster en Ingeniería Informática, Ciencia de Datos, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
Experiencia mínima de 3-4 años de experiencia desarrollando proyectos de Machine Learning & Deep Learning
Experiencia sólida en el uso y puesta en producción de librerías de ML tradicional (scikit-learn) y Deep Learning (TensorFlow o PyTorch).
Sólidos conocimientos en redes neuronales, arquitecturas y métodos de evaluación de modelos.
Experiencia en prototipar soluciones software basadas en ML y capacidad para definir la experimentación necesaria.




Valorable:

Valoramos conocimientos en desarrollo de software de calidad: tests, automatización, pipelines de CI (Jenkins), etc.
Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa trabajando con herramientas del entorno AWS (S3, Lambda, ECR), orquestación con Apache Airflow, bases de datos NoSQL (MongoDB) y plataformas de datos como Databricks.

Modalidad de trabajo híbrida en Vallès Occcidental.
Flexibilidad horaria.
Ticket restaurante, seguro médico y plan de retribución flexible.
Trabajo con tecnologías modernas y equipos multidisciplinares.
Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y aprendizaje continuo.

Title: Associate Data Scientist
Description:
Description

The opportunity

ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.

You will join an established team and contribute to data science and AI work across varied client projects. Working with more experienced colleagues, you will prepare data, test analytical approaches, help develop prototypes and communicate what the results mean. You will gain exposure to the consulting process, learning how to turn complex client questions into practical analyses and communicate findings to a range of audiences.

What You Will Do


Work with data scientists and subject matter experts to understand project questions, available data and appropriate outputs.
Clean, combine and explore datasets, write clear Python and document your assumptions and checks.
Build and compare straightforward statistical or machine learning models, use suitable baselines and help evaluate accuracy, limitations and potential bias.
Contribute to prototypes using methods suited to the problem, including language models where appropriate, and test outputs carefully before sharing them.
Prepare charts, concise written findings and presentation material, explain your work to colleagues and, with support, to clients and subject matter experts.
Use feedback and code review to improve your work, and contribute to reproducible project files and team knowledge sharing.


What You Will Bring


Hands-on experience applying data science through a project, research, internship or commercial work.
Experience using Python gained through employment, an internship, research or substantial personal or academic projects.
A grounding in statistics and common machine learning methods, such as regression or classification, and experience of training, testing and model evaluation.
Care with data quality, documentation and clear, reproducible code, willingness to learn version control and collaborative development practices.
Curiosity about real client problems, willingness to ask questions and ability to explain your thinking in clear written and spoken English.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative or social science field.


Useful Additional Experience


Exposure to public policy, government, research or evaluation.
Hands-on exploration of large language models, including checking responses against source material, experience with AI agents is welcome but not required.
Experience with Git, cloud services, data visualisation, collaborative projects or presenting technical work to a nontechnical audience.


What You Can Expect

You will learn from colleagues with a range of technical and subject expertise while contributing to complex, varied projects. We will support your career development through ongoing training, feedback and opportunities to deepen both your data science and consulting skills. As your experience grows, you will take on more responsibility in shaping and delivering solutions.

Right to Work, Location & Sponsorship

Role

We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in the world. For roles located in the UK, Belgium, Spain, or Germany, applicants must:


Hold the right to work in the country where the role is based, or be eligible for visa sponsorship, which we may consider on a case-by-case basis, and
Be physically present in that country by their first day of employment (or able to relocate beforehand).


Unless stated otherwise, relocation support is not automatically provided.

Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodations that involve the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
ABOUT US

In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best-in-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.

LIFE AT TKWW

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life’s most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

TKWW is looking for a Senior  Data Scientist to join our team of data professionals supporting our Marketplace. The Senior  Data Scientist will play a critical role in shaping data strategy, guiding experimentation, and driving impact through advanced analytics. They will partner with cross-functional teams—including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders—to design experiments, develop analytical tools, and ensure we are making data-driven decisions that deliver measurable results. As a trusted advisor and mentor, this person will both lead analyses directly and elevate the work of the broader team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Gather, analyze, and interpret data to deliver business impact and help the organization make informed decisions
Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, causal inference) to uncover insights and guide strategy
Forecast and simulate hypotheticals to provide early potential signals before large initiatives start
Design and analyze A/B and multivariate testing experiments; guide experimentation best practices across teams
Design, build, and maintain reusable, scalable data products and self-serve capabilities used by multiple internal teams
Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations, linking insights to business outcomes such as ROI, conversion, retention, and revenue
Maintain a deep understanding of the product, relevant data assets, and the outcomes of past experiments and analyses
Identify opportunities for new data products and integrations, prioritize a backlog of data assets and use cases, and collaborate with business partners to implement them
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure strong internal customer focus and alignment
Partner with engineers to ensure appropriate and scalable tracking is in place

 

REQUIREMENTS:
Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Strong business acumen and ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions and decision frameworks
Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment through data-driven insights and recommendations
Advanced knowledge of statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference, and forecasting
Hands-on experience with experiment design, analysis, and rollout of A/B and multivariate tests
Advanced SQL skills and ability to write efficient, production-ready queries
Strong Python skills for data manipulation, visualization, and advanced analysis
Knowledge of data modeling and experience partnering with engineers on data infrastructure
Experience prioritizing and managing analytical work, data assets, or product backlogs in a cross-functional environment
Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field preferred
2+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, with some prior leadership, mentorship, or project ownership experience
Fluent in English & Spanish  

WORK MODEL:

This role is Together@TKWW-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You’ll be expected to work in the office two days a week as part of our hybrid work model.

 

  

#professional 

AI FLUENCY

At TKWW, AI is a tool that helps our teams work smarter, move faster, and spend more time on the work that matters most. We expect every employee, in every role, to build fluency with the AI tools relevant to their work, use them thoughtfully and with sound judgment, and bring curiosity as these tools keep evolving. This isn't about replacing our people's expertise — it's about equipping every employee to use AI to raise the bar on the work we do together.

WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:

Commit to our customers: You act as one team on behalf of our customers. You lead with head and heart, and build what matters for life's most meaningful moments.
Raise the bar: You define "great" and work backwards. You don't just accept how it's been done, but boldly define how it should be. You are unafraid to innovate, learn, and keep moving forward toward our shared vision.
Be all in: You believe in our mission and take ownership of your work. You debate openly to reach the best outcomes, speaking with clarity and care, embracing diverse perspectives, then commit fully.
Celebrate impact: You measure success by the outcomes you create. You hold yourself accountable to delivering value, while recognizing progress and the lessons learned along the way.  You love to win, together.

WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:

We provide meaningful, high-impact benefits designed to support the holistic well-being of our diverse workforce and help our people thrive both professionally and personally. From physical and mental wellness to flexible time off our programs are built around the moments that matter most.

TOGETHER@TKWW: OUR APPROCH TO HYBRID WORK

Together@TKWW is designed to support how we work best: combining the flexibility we value with meaningful opportunities to connect in person. Whether a role is Together@TKWW-eligible or not, we believe in purposeful moments to come together, build strong relationships, and drive bold ideas forward.
For Together@TKWW-eligible roles, this includes regular in-office time to foster collaboration and connection.
For roles not eligible for in-office expectations, we support connection through virtual collaboration and intentional gatherings.

To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have office spaces in Barcelona, Spain; Delhi, India; Galway, Ireland; London, England and New York, NY.

Title: Data Scientist - (Hybrid)
Description:
Data Scientist (They/She/He) - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Data Scientist to join our Data Science Team in Barcelona. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there. You will have the opportunity to either crunch massive datasets using the latest Big Data technologies or solve a quick problem with an already classic algorithm. We always promote using the best tool for each task. You will be a key player in the organization by designing and implementing advanced analytics and using machine learning to build AI-powered solutions for almost every area in the business like online fraud detection, recommendation engines, user experience personalization, optimizing the flight combinations we offer or the marketing campaigns we launch, and virtually every possible area subject to optimization in the business etc. Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

Our dynamic team of young, talented professionals from over 60 different nationalities is driven by one clear mission: making travel easier, more accessible, and create better value for our 18 million customers worldwide. Inside our Data Science team, we research and build cutting-edge solutions to be able to offer more and better combinations of tailored travel plans than any other site. We have dozens of machine learning models in production doing hundreds of thousands of predictions that optimize our processes, improve the content for our customers and help us adapt to changes in the market. The team is constantly analyzing the past to understand it, and predicting the future to guide business on making the decisions that drive the most value both for our customers and our business.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – 7M members in Prime

More than 100 million searches per day - Up to 6 billion daily AI predictions[e1]

Over 1,600 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts - 36 average age

We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Data Scientist in the Data Science team you will be in charge of:


Conduct predictive analytics to better understand how our customers interact with our products and help us anticipate their needs.
Collaborate with Product and Business teams in order to embed Machine Learning into our apps, services and products and create predictive models and generate insights from our data.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning technologies and Data Science trends.
Effectively communicate results and insights with other stakeholders throughout the organization.



What you need to succeed:

Job Requirements

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or other quantitative fields).
2+ years of related experience as a Data Scientist, Machine Learning engineer or similar.
Previous experience in problem-solving, strong analytical and technical skills.
You have a solid understanding of appropriate statistical, data mining and machine learning methods for various analysis situations.
Strong experience coding in Python. Other programming languages like Scala, R, or Java are also valued.
Experience using frameworks like, Spark, Tensorflow and the already classic libraries like scikit-learn, pandas, etc.
Solid knowledge and use of SQL is important. Experience in Big Data technologies; such as distributed computing, NoSQL/graph databases or architectures based on Kubernetes, airflow or Kafka would be a plus.
You are committed to following good practices and conventions, from code versioning to QA processes and monitorization.
Written and oral communication skills (in English).



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!
