Title: Experienced AI/ML Engineer (f/m/d)
Description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As an AI/ML Engineer in the Applied AI Solutions team, you will use the range of statistical, machine learning and LLM techniques, tools, models and agents (‘AI’) to enable the company’s digital finance operations by automation. You will be a key contributor to Siemens Energy finance center of excellence for applied AI and automation. You’ll work closely with solution architects, product managers, other data and AI engineers and finance experts/stakeholders to prototype, build and test scalable, production-ready AI solutions. Your day will involve deep thinking, coding and designing time, including involve Finance stakeholder interactions, experimentation, technique and algorithm selection, model training or querying, accuracy evaluations, or integration of AI into digital finance platforms.

How You’ll Make An Impact


Development and deployment of AI-driven solutions to address business challenges such as forecasting, anomaly detection, and document classification
Design and implementation of data pipelines and cloud-based architectures for experimentation, model training, validation, and testing
Integration of AI components into automation workflows, digital finance platforms, and microservice-based architectures
Rapid prototyping of AI models and contribution to MVP development within Agile teams
Continuous evaluation and optimization of AI performance for accuracy, scalability, and compliance with data privacy and security standards
Collaboration with AI and data engineers to design reusable components, share best practices, and mentor junior team members



What You Bring


University degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or comparable qualifications gained through professional experience
Proven experience in developing and deploying AI-based automation solutions in applied business environments, ideally within the Finance domain
Expertise in Python, AWS, Snowflake, and AI frameworks for production-grade implementation
Strong decision-making skills balancing enterprise architecture, budget, and resource constraints, with experience leading engineering teams
Solid understanding of Agile principles and modern software development practices
Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with state-of-the-art AI advancements



About The Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits


In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical



We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Descrição da função/Principais responsabilidades:
  • Apoiar a recolha, limpeza e preparação de dados para análise;

  • Desenvolver visualizações e dashboards usando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou similares;

  • Construir modelos estatísticos e preditivos com supervisão de cientistas de dados sénior;

  • Realizar análises exploratórias de dados para identificar padrões e tendências;

  • Documentar procedimentos e manter o código bem organizado e reutilizável;

  • Colaborar com stakeholders para compreender requisitos de negócio e traduzir em análises.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Mestrado ou PhD em Estatística, Matemática, Informática, Engenharia ou área relacionada;

  • 2 a 3 anos de experiência profissional com Python, R ou SQL;

  • Conhecimentos básicos de Bash e Git;

  • Conhecimentos de Machine Learning e estatística;

  • Experiência na formação e teste de modelos, no tratamento de grandes volumes de dados e na aplicação de técnicas de Data Science para lidar com redução de dimensionalidade, leakage, overfitting, entre outros;

  • Boas capacidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipa;

  • Curiosidade intelectual e vontade de aprender continuamente.

Requisitos preferenciais:
  • Desenvolvimento e implementação de modelos em ambientes cloud, como o GCP.
  • Experiência em monitorização de performance de modelos.
  • Conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial Generativa e/ou Visão Computacional.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Wiliot was founded by the team that invented one of the technologies at the heart of 5G. Their next vision was to develop an IoT sticker, a computing element that can power itself by harvesting radio frequency energy, bringing connectivity and intelligence to everyday products and packaging, things previously disconnect from the IoT. This revolutionary mixture of cloud and semiconductor technology is being used by some of the world’s largest consumer, retail, food and pharmaceutical companies to change the way we make, distribute, sell, use and recycle products.

Our investors include Softbank, Amazon, Alibaba, Verizon, NTT DoCoMo, Qualcomm and PepsiCo.

This role offers a unique opportunity to engage in tactical data exploration and to build out solutions on top of the insights you identify. You will sift through massive amounts of data to discover “Ah ha!” moments for key customers that connect the dots between our technology and their key problems. You will then work with internal teams, and key customer teams to turn these insights into integrated solutions. Creativity, curiosity, and resilience are key for this role as you often won’t know what we’re looking for until we’ve found it.

Responsibilities:


Participate in customer meetings and carefully listen for pain points and business problems
Develop visualization interfaces (internally and in customer systems) to maximize data value and useability in the customer business context
Mold real time series data stream into actional insights
Hunt to uncover new insights in data generated by customer deployments
Build and deliver technical presentations to customers
Communicate effectively with engineers from many disciplines (including algorithm, software, and hardware engineers)
Work with internal product teams and customer teams to turn insights into integrated solutions.


Requirements:


Bachelor's degree in Math, CS, data science/engineering or equivalent analytical degree
4-5 years of relevant professional experience
Architecture experience in big data, data warehousing, operational analytics and integration.
Optimize the performance of big data systems to design and implement efficient analytics algorithms.
Strong Python skills
Experience with SPARK strongly preferred.
Visualization tools experience including UI design (Plotly, Tableau, PowerBI, Grafana)
Understanding of statistical analysis and relational database structures (SQL, Influxdb a plus)
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving abilities
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to be self-sufficient and execute quickly when given autonomy
Experience with IoT data streams and business context a plus
Flexible team player who will thrive in a dynamic, constantly evolving environment

Description:
Iterable is the AI customer engagement platform, built for enterprise scale, loved by teams, and trusted by global brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box. Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data from any source, design seamless cross-channel experiences, and optimize engagement with Nova Intelligence, the AI layer of our platform, all with enterprise-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences.

Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values to life every day: Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, and Transparency. And the market has noticed: G2 recognizes Iterable as a Leader globally, spanning the Americas, EMEA, APAC, ANZ, and Latin America, with category leadership in Personalization, Marketing Automation, Push Notifications, and Mobile Marketing, and a 4.5/5-star rating from hundreds of users. Gartner named Iterable a Challenger in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Multichannel Marketing in both 2024 and 2025. We’ve also earned TrustRadius Top Rated honors in 2024 and 2025, were named a TrustRadius Buyer’s Choice for 2026, and were featured in Snowflake’s Modern Marketing Data Stack 2026.

With a global presence that includes offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together!

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Iterable, you will design and build the end-to-end machine learning systems that power intelligence across our product. As a high-tech marketing platform, we work with thousands of large-scale and diverse enterprise customers. The scale and diversity of these workloads — supporting personalization with deep customizability — present unique and exciting challenges for machine learning at production scale.

You will have real autonomy: from research and experimentation through to models running reliably in production, you'll own the systems and models behind our ML products and help shape the direction of AI at Iterable.

One of our core values is a growth mindset, and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this role excites you, please apply — we value applicants for the skills they bring beyond a job description.

What You'll Do


Build and ship core product ML capabilities, including send-time/frequency optimization, recommendation engines, and campaign personalization.
Own the full model lifecycle end-to-end: EDA, feature engineering, distributed training, production deployment, latency monitoring, and online experimentation (e.g., multi-armed bandits, ensemble models).
Build and scale our data pipelines and serving architectures using Databricks, Spark, AWS, Ray, and Kubernetes.
Partner with Backend and Platform teams to elevate feature serving, improve overall data architecture, and establish engineering standards across the team.
Mentor engineers on the team and help set the technical direction for ML at Iterable.


What We're Looking For


5+ years of hands-on MLE experience putting complex models into production at scale.
Databricks & Spark mastery: Real experience building, optimizing, and scaling production data pipelines using Databricks.
Production-level Model Engineering: Proven track record of taking deep learning and ensemble architectures from training through optimization to production deployment.
Production Code: Strong Python and/or Scala skills with an emphasis on readable, modular, and maintainable systems code.
Systems & Infra Experience: Hands-on work with microservice backends, distributed compute (Ray/Spark), and containers (Kubernetes).
Pragmatism: You care more about serving latency, reliability, and measurable customer impact than novel theoretical architectures.


Bonus Points


Prior work on large-scale recommendation systems.
Experience setting up feature stores or model observability tools.
Exposure to Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi).


You Might Work On


Building, evaluating, and integrating new models that add intelligence into our core product.
Enhancing models that optimize send time and frequency of outgoing message campaigns.
Designing data pipelines that make it easy to implement and test new models.
Working with platform engineers to enhance our feature- and model-serving architecture.
Benchmarking and improving our multi-armed bandit implementation.
Building tools to visualize and debug features and models.

Competitive salaries & meaningful equity
Private Medical Insurance
Life/Risk Assurance
Meal Allowance: 8.55€ per day
Community Days (days for us to give back to the community)
Paid Annual Leave (22 days)
Global Lifestyle Reimbursement Account
Paid Sabbatical
Complete laptop workstation

Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.



Responsibilities:



Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).

AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!

Working closely with Learning and Development colleagues, business stakeholders, product owners, and the DevOps team, the Digital Learning & AI Specialist will identify business needs and translate them into clear functional requirements. The role will support the design, development, testing, validation, and documentation of solutions including AI-powered tools, workflow automations, data integrations, and Power BI applications.

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will:


Support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Future of Field capabilities and digital learning solutions.
Test, validate, and document AI features, automated workflows, Power BI applications, and other digital tools to ensure they meet business needs and deliver value.
Support demonstrations and showcase MyGenius, Amgen’s in-house AI ecosystem, and other relevant digital capabilities to business stakeholders.
Research emerging AI, automation, analytics, and learning technologies and contribute to Proofs of Concept that evaluate innovative ideas.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Future of Field and learning-related use cases, translating business needs into clear functional requirements.
Collaborate with product owners, Learning and Development colleagues, field-facing teams, and technical teams to support the design and delivery of solutions.
Build and maintain Power BI applications, reports, dashboards, and data visualizations that help stakeholders make informed decisions.
Support process automation and data integration activities to improve efficiency, user experience, and access to relevant insights.
Create and maintain functional designs, process flows, system interface diagrams, technical specifications, and supporting documentation.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Contribute to the adoption, communication, and ongoing enhancement of digital solutions across the Future of Field ecosystem.


WIN

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a curious, collaborative, and business-oriented professional with an interest in Learning and Development, field capabilities, artificial intelligence, automation, analytics, and digital product delivery.

Minimum Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Learning and Development, Business Technology, or a related field.
At least 1-3 years of experience in digital product delivery, business analysis, learning and development, technology consulting, data analytics, software development, or a related role.
Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into functional requirements.
Experience supporting the testing, validation, documentation, and delivery of digital products or technology solutions.
Proficiency in English.


Preferred Requirements


Interest in artificial intelligence, generative AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
Experience with Power BI, including dashboard development, reporting, data modeling, and visualization.
Familiarity with Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate.
Experience with AI and automation platforms, including MyGenius, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or comparable generative AI tools.
Familiarity with data, integration, and cloud technologies such as AWS, Databricks, Tableau, MuleSoft, Informatica, GitHub, or Jira.
Experience supporting Proofs of Concept, prompt engineering, AI evaluation, or agentic AI frameworks.
Familiarity with programming and data-query languages such as Python, SQL, JavaScript, or similar.
Knowledge of the commercial, learning, or field-facing environment within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or similarly regulated industries.
Experience collaborating with product owners, Learning and Development colleagues, business stakeholders, field-facing teams, and technical or DevOps teams.
Experience supporting digital product delivery within an Agile environment, including participation in stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical, data-driven problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and take accountability for delivery.
Strong ownership, accountability, and follow-through.
An Agile mindset and willingness to learn and adopt new technologies.


THRIVE

What You Can Expect Of Us


Vast opportunities to learn, develop, and move up and across our global organization.
Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where colleagues are empowered to bring ideas to the table, take risks, and act.
Generous AMGEN Total Rewards Plan comprising healthcare, finance, wealth, and career benefits.
Flexible work arrangements.


APPLY NOW

Title: Data & AI Consultant
Description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

Efficio’s Product & Engineering team is an internal function of 60+ people driving innovation in the high-potential e-Procurement space. They are responsible for the development of software and data solutions and tools that enable our consulting teams to deliver better and faster outcomes to our customers. Product & Engineering is pivotal to scaling our business and services and comprises specialised teams in Applications Development, Data Services, AI and Infrastructure.

We are looking for a Data & AI Consultant to join a fast-growing client-facing technology team. This is not a traditional data engineering role, and it is not a pure consulting role. It sits at the intersection of engineering, AI implementation, technical advisory, and client delivery.

You will work directly with a major global client, helping them understand, design, and implement AI-enabled solutions within their own data and technology environment. Rather than simply building products in isolation, you will guide stakeholders through the journey from problem definition to roadmap creation, MVP development, and scalable implementation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both building and advising: someone who can speak confidently with senior stakeholders, translate business problems into technical roadmaps, and work hands-on with Python, AWS, APIs, databases, CI/CD pipelines, and AI models.

What you'll do:

As a Data & AI Consultant, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering AI-enabled data solutions for a major client. Your responsibilities will vary depending on the workstream, but will typically include:


Working directly with client stakeholders, from senior leaders and board-level audiences to technical teams and day-to-day users, to understand business problems and translate them into practical technical solutions.
Supporting the definition of AI and data workstreams, including requirements gathering, technical discovery, roadmap creation, prioritisation, and implementation planning.
Designing and developing MVPs that demonstrate how AI, data pipelines, APIs, and cloud infrastructure can be used to solve real client problems.
Guiding client and partner engineering teams on how to build, integrate, and scale solutions within their own data pipelines and technology environment.
Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, product teams, external engineering teams, and internal Efficio specialists.
Advising on the use of AI models within data engineering processes, including prompting, AI engineering patterns, workflow automation, and integration into production pipelines.
Supporting solution design across AWS, Python-based applications, databases, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and scalable data infrastructure.
Bringing a consulting mindset to delivery: structuring ambiguity, communicating clearly, preparing presentations, and helping stakeholders make informed decisions.
Contributing to Efficio’s broader technology and IP ecosystem, including selected touchpoints with internal tools and products such as contract review and procurement intelligence capabilities.


What we are looking for:


Experience in a technical consulting, data engineering, AI engineering, analytics engineering, backend engineering, or solution engineering role.
Strong Python skills and experience building robust, maintainable technical solutions.
Experience working with cloud environments, ideally AWS.
Practical understanding of data pipelines, databases, APIs, CI/CD practices, and production-quality engineering.
Familiarity with AI engineering concepts, such as prompt engineering, LLM integration, RAG patterns, model-enabled workflows, or using AI models within data and analytics processes.
The ability to understand complex business problems and translate them into technical roadmaps, implementation plans, and delivery milestones.
Confidence communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior client audiences.
Experience creating technical documentation, presentations, solution designs, or delivery plans.
Comfort working in ambiguity, especially in an early-stage or evolving role where structure is still being defined.
A willingness to be hands-on when needed, whether that means building an MVP, reviewing architecture, working with APIs, or supporting implementation decisions.


This is an opportunity to join early in the growth of a client-facing AI engineering capability. You will be one of the first hires into this type of role, which means you will have room to shape how we deliver, how we engage with clients, and how we combine consulting with modern AI and data engineering.

The role will initially involve a significant amount of client interaction, discovery, requirements gathering, and roadmap development. Over time, it is expected to remain a balanced mix of engineering and client-facing delivery, with approximately half of the work focused on technical implementation and half on stakeholder engagement, presentations, and consulting-style problem solving.

You should be comfortable with a role that is still evolving. There will be less predefined structure than in a mature product or engineering team, but there will also be more opportunity to influence the direction of the work. At times, delivery may be demanding due to client deadlines and expectations.

Travel requirements are still being confirmed, but candidates should be open to travelling for client meetings when needed.

Our collaborative and inclusive culture is what makes us stand out. At Efficio, colleagues with diverse backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints come together to identify innovative solutions for our clients - and so we're looking for our new team members to bring strong communication, empathy, and relationship-building skills to maintain this culture as we grow.

We encourage our teams to proactively innovate and challenge the status-quo, backed by strong analytical thinking, creative problem-solving and technical expertise.   • Experience creating technical documentation, presentations, solution designs, or delivery plans.

Develop, maintain, and optimise Qlik Sense dashboards and analytical solutions.

You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges.

Qualifications & Experience

Relevant academic background in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
4+ years of experience with Qlik Sense in business intelligence and analytics projects.
Strong experience using SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver reporting solutions.
Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese.

Technical & Professional Skills

Strong hands-on expertise in Qlik Sense development and dashboard design.
Advanced knowledge of SQL and working with large datasets.
Ability to explore and interpret data independently, generating valuable business insights.
Strong understanding of Business Intelligence, reporting, and data visualisation best practices.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Ability to translate business requirements into effective data solutions.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Experience working in cross-functional environments with both technical and business teams.




Nice to Have

Experience within the Logistics or Supply Chain domain.
Knowledge of additional BI tools such as QlikView, Power BI, or Tableau.
Relevant certifications in Qlik, Business Intelligence, or Data Analytics.
Experience in consulting or client-facing environments.
Exposure to international projects or multicultural teams.
Additional certifications or specialised domain expertise.




⭐ What Makes You Successful

You focus on outcomes rather than activity.
You approach challenges with curiosity and pragmatism.
You communicate complex concepts in a clear and accessible way.
You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding practical solutions.
You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others.
You combine autonomy with collaboration.
You continuously look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and results.

Competitive salary aligned with your experience and the data market
Meal allowance: €10.20/day
Flexible benefits plan
Private medical insurance
22 days of annual leave, increasing every 3 years (up to 25 days)
Continuous learning via KLX – Keyrus Learning Experience
A collaborative, international, and human-centred work environment

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect different levels of mastery and impact within the same role — not different job titles.

Bottom of the range You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
Middle of the range You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
Top of the range You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

To ensure fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is strictly prohibited.

Our commitment to responsible AI practices ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.




⚠️ Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

Intelligence Foundations,
Human in Command governance,

Queres integrar uma das maiores organizações na prestação de serviços profissionais do mercado?

Então a Deloitte é para ti. Aqui, vais ter a possibilidade de potenciar a tua carreira e de reforçar as tuas competências no nosso universo tecnológico.

Somos um Tech Hub internacional e estamos à procura dos melhores especialistas em SAP para se juntarem aos nossos centros de excelência e à nossa comunidade. Podes descobrir todas as funções que vais desempenhar, de acordo com o teu perfil, para assim dares um salto na tua carreira!

Juntas-te a nós? Estamos à tua espera.

  • Integrar e participar ativamente em projetos de consultoria SAP, na vertente de Advanced Analytics/Data Science e de Consolidação Financeira;

  • Desenvolvimento da prática de Analytics e contribuir para comunidades de conhecimento em diferentes áreas de foco.

  • Experiência/interesse em integrar projetos de implementação de raiz;
  • Espírito empreendedor, dinâmico e proactivo;
  • Autonomia, capacidade analítica e espírito crítico;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipa;
  • Boas capacidades de comunicação orais e escritas em Português e Inglês, incluindo técnicas de apresentação;
  • Localização: Lisboa, Porto ou Braga, com disponibilidade para viajar.

  • Através de um plano de desenvolvimento de carreira personalizado (skills/ oportunidades técnicas e funcionais), adequado ao momento, às tuas necessidades e objetivos;

  • Oportunidade de formações e certificações nas mais recentes tecnologias, nomeadamente em tecnologias Cloud.

  • Uma cultura de inovação e excelência que nos torna líderes e precursores de tendências;
  • Um ambiente amigável, de respeito, confiança, transparência e informalidade;
  • Uma rede para a vida que te faz estar ligado ao melhor conhecimento ao lado de líderes e especialistas;

Title: Senior Pricing & Revenue Performance Specialist
Description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?







We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.   










Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 










It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 










Ready to awaken your best with us? 







 




About the Role




 







As Senior Pricing & Revenue Performance Specialist, you'll be responsible for ensuring that Emma captures the full commercial value of its product portfolio — by connecting revenue performance, pricing architecture, and competitive intelligence into actionable insight.




This is a newly created role designed to address one of the most critical gaps identified in the category diagnostic: the absence of a structured pricing framework, a clear performance intelligence function, and a structured competitive monitoring capability. Today, pricing decisions lack governance, performance tracking is high-level, and competitive intelligence is fragmented. This role exists to fix that.




You will build the analytical backbone of Category Management — providing the data, frameworks, and strategic insight that make better portfolio decisions possible, and ensuring that pricing logic holds across markets, channels, and the full product lifecycle.







What you'll do:


1. Category Performance Intelligence





Design, build and own global category performance dashboards in partnership with BI and Data teams


Define the KPI framework for the category: which metrics matter, how they are measured, and at what frequency


Track and analyse product performance across all global markets:



Revenue, volume, and margin by SKU, channel, and market


Return rate and NPS correlation with product attributes and positioning


Portfolio mix evolution and contribution margin by tier


Channel performance across DTC, marketplace, and retail








Identify performance gaps, growth opportunities, and structural category issues — and translate them into clear recommendations


Produce monthly performance reviews and quarterly category performance deep-dives for senior stakeholders


Build the category portfolio assessment framework (combining CM, return rate, revenue, and mix) to steer investment and rationalisation decisions







2. Pricing Architecture & Value Capture





Design and maintain global price ladders, pricing tiers, and trade-up logic for each product category


Define pricing corridors by channel, market cluster, and product tier — ensuring coherence across the portfolio


Maintain & update a pricing elasticity model to inform strategic pricing decisions and promotional planning


Support pricing decisions for new product launches — working closely with Global Category Managers and Finance


Conduct regular price-value assessments: are products priced coherently relative to consumer-perceived value and competitive positioning?


Identify pricing risks (undercutting, margin compression, channel conflict) and propose corrective actions


Build a pricing governance framework ensuring decisions are documented, consistent, and defensible







3. Promotional Governance & ROI Framework





Define promo guardrails and governance standards (frequency, depth, product eligibility, channel fit)


Build and maintain a promotional effectiveness tracking model — measuring actual ROI vs planned


Collaborate with countries to conduct pre- and post-promo analysis to identify what works, at what cost, and for which products


Work with Regional Category Managers to evaluate EU, APAC, and LATAM promo requests against global guardrails


Identify structural promo dependency risks (habituation, margin erosion, brand degradation) and escalate early


Partner with Finance and Commercial to ensure promo plans are margin-accretive or strategically justified







4. Competitive & Market Intelligence





Own and continuously maintain a structured competitive landscape view across Emma's core categories


Track competitor pricing, product launches, positioning changes, and promotional activity across key markets


Develop a repeatable, scalable competitive intelligence process — pulling from multiple sources (online scraping, trade press, field reports, mystery shopping)


Analyse market sizing, category growth rates, and channel shifts to identify whitespace and strategic risks


Deliver regular competitive intelligence reports and ad-hoc briefs when significant competitor moves occur


Support business case modelling with validated market data and external benchmarks







5. Category Decision Support & Business Cases





Serve as the analytical partner to Global and Regional Category Managers — providing the data backbone for strategic decisions


Build and validate business cases for new product investments, portfolio changes, and category expansion


Support market sizing exercises, opportunity assessments, and go/no-go frameworks for innovation


Work with Finance to translate category insights into P&L impact, investment return projections, and budget inputs


Develop self-service analytics tools and templates that help the broader category team make faster, better decisions










Who we are looking for:

Title: Senior Data Modeller
Description:
YOUR ROLE

You will lead a modelling strategy for scientific data harmonization work. This work aims to strengthen mechanistic understanding of disease and make integrated FAIR data products available to R&D scientists for rapid query and decision-making. You turn ambiguous scientific requirements into clear canonical models, make and document ontology decisions, and set the standards for identifiers, provenance and schema governance across data assets.


Lead modelling strategy across data harmonization, pipeline validation, knowledge graph and FAIR data product requirements
Translate ambiguous scientific requirements into clear conceptual, logical and canonical data models
Model biomedical entities and relationships including genes, targets, diseases, indications, phenotypes, mechanisms, biomarkers, tissues, cell types, assay modalities, evidence, provenance and causal relationships
Make ontology reuse, extension and mapping decisions, with documented rationale
Define persistent identifiers and consistent provenance fields across data assets
Drive schema review, approval, versioning and publication processes in GitHub, including changelogs, tagged releases and downstream impact assessment
Define validation rules and data quality checks for ontology terms, ranges, required fields, ID and label consistency, cross-field consistency and provenance completeness
Identify modelling risks early: metadata gaps, ontology conflicts, source data quality issues, lineage gaps and downstream compatibility problems
Design modular, reusable and future-proof models aligned to FAIR principles and enterprise standards
Work with scientific knowledge engineering, biology SMEs, data engineering, knowledge graph engineering, product management, data stewards and platform teams
Mentor junior and mid-level modelers


YOUR PROFILE


MSc or PhD (or equivalent professional experience) in biology, biomedical sciences, bioengineering, genetics, neuroscience, bioinformatics, computational biology or a related field
More than 6 years of experience in scientific or biomedical data modelling, data harmonization or knowledge engineering, with senior ownership
Strong conceptual, logical and canonical modelling experience for complex biomedical or scientific domains
Practical, in-depth experience with LinkML or an equivalent schema framework: classes, slots, ranges, identifiers, required fields, constraints, cardinality, descriptions and ontology bindings
Strong data harmonization experience: source-to-canonical mapping, controlled vocabulary alignment, persistent identifiers, lineage and provenance
Proven experience defining validation rules and data quality checks: ontology term validity, ranges, required fields, ID and label consistency, cross-field consistency and provenance completeness
Strong understanding of FAIR principles, metadata standards, provenance and schema versioning
Strong command of biomedical ontologies and vocabularies such as HGNC, Ensembl, UniProt, MONDO, Disease Ontology, HPO, EFO, UBERON, Cell Ontology, Gene Ontology, Reactome, KEGG, ChEBI, OBI, LOINC, UCUM, ECO, SEPIO, Relation Ontology and PATO
Experience managing the schema lifecycle with GitHub-based repositories, semantic versioning, changelogs, data dictionaries and metadata catalogues
Experience designing models that support pipelines, APIs, knowledge graphs, FAIR data products and analytical workflows
Solid Python and a working command of SQL, used for validation, mapping checks and exploration of real biomedical datasets
A public or shareable repository (GitHub, GitLab or similar) demonstrating schema and governance work. Please include the link in your application
Excellent stakeholder management and communication;
Fluent English


Preferred Qualifications


Semantic modelling technologies: RDF, OWL, JSON-LD, SHACL, ShEx and SPARQL; knowledge graph modelling
Schema or model registry, data catalogue and metadata registry tooling
Lineage and provenance modelling, and FAIR metadata assessment
Query-based validation using SQL or Python and notebooks for model conformance, ontology mapping or data quality checks
Agentic AI or LLM-assisted mapping and curation, with robust validation
Experience in pharmaceutical R&D or another regulated research environment
Cloud platforms, Docker and workflow orchestration
Applied machine learning and/or broad data science
Experience mentoring or leading a small technical team
Scientific curiosity paired with engineering discipline
Critical thinking and attention to data provenance and quality
Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to move between scientific meaning and technical implementation
An impact-driven mindset in a fast-paced environment
Portuguese fluency

Title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
Description:
Job Description

About the Team:

The Requirements Portal delivers essential features on the Altium Develop/Agile platform for engineering teams to collaborate on their product requirements. It covers the entire lifecycle from importing with smart importers customer requirements, collaborating on them, connecting them to the electronics design, verifying them and creating relevant compliance documents.


Shape the future: You'll be part of a close-knit team with ambitious goals, but you'll also have the freedom and power to define the best way to achieve them. Collaborate with your team to map out the features and technical path that will bring our product vision to life;
Grow together, share knowledge: We foster a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing. You'll have the opportunity to learn from and mentor your teammates, contributing to a collaborative environment where everyone thrives;


If you like the idea of working in an environment that encourages creative and autonomous work, focuses on your growth potential and where there’s always room to discuss the quirks of living on this planet, then we might just be a perfect fit.

About The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our team working at the frontier of applied AI in Requirements Management and Hardware Engineering more in general.

At Enovis™ we pay attention to the details. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients, and take pride in the pursuit of scientific excellence, with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it.

Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.

Job Title

Digital Performance & Analytics Lead

Reports To

Head of Global Digital CoE

Location:

Lisbon, Portugal – Hybrid

Business Unit Description

Global Digital Center of Excellence – Data, Analytics & Insights

Job Title/High-Level Position Summary

The Digital Performance & Analytics Lead establishes a standardized measurement framework that provides objective visibility into traffic, conversion, lead generation, and overall digital performance across Enovis' businesses.

Working within the Global Digital Center of Excellence, and in the spirit of the Enovis Growth Excellence (EGX) continuous-improvement culture, the role will create a single source of truth for digital performance, transforming fragmented reporting into shared, actionable insights that drive investment, prioritization, and optimization decisions.

This role will work across brands, regions, and digital properties, partnering with business units, Digital CoE teams, IT, and external partners to establish consistent performance standards and strengthen data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Define and implement the KPI framework, dashboards, and performance reporting for the global digital ecosystem.
Generate actionable insights across conversion, growth, lead generation, traffic, and overall digital performance to inform prioritization and optimization decisions.
Establish governance standards for attribution, reporting quality, and data consistency.
Partner with business unit and Digital CoE teams to translate complex data into clear business insights, decisions, and measurable actions.
Apply consistent measurement and reporting standards across brands, regions, and digital properties.
Support investment and optimization decisions through objective, comparable performance data.
Improve visibility into digital performance and ROI, helping teams understand where investment and optimization efforts can deliver the greatest impact.
Promote a strong data-driven and continuous-improvement culture across the global digital ecosystem.
Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Basic Qualifications


Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital analytics, measurement, and performance reporting.
Demonstrated experience defining KPI frameworks and driving data governance within a multi-stakeholder environment.
Strong command of analytics platforms, dashboards, and attribution methodologies.
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics or an equivalent web analytics platform.
Experience with marketing attribution tools and methodologies.
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Excellent communication skills; English required.
Microsoft Office proficiency required.


Desired Characteristics


Experience with web and eCommerce analytics and tag management.
Experience working within global or multi-brand digital ecosystems.
Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and data integration.
Strong analytical mindset combined with the ability to translate data into a compelling business story.
Excellent ability to communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong business-impact and results orientation.
Ability to work effectively across business units, Digital CoE teams, IT, and external partners.
Curious, proactive, and insight-driven mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities beyond standard reporting.
Strong focus on continuous improvement, data quality, and measurable business outcomes.


What Success Looks Like


Digital performance dashboards are widely adopted, with KPIs consistently applied across business units.
Increased ability to translate insights into clear actions and optimization opportunities.
Improved visibility into conversion performance, traffic, lead generation, and digital growth.
Stronger data and performance discipline across Enovis' global digital ecosystem.
Clearer and more consistent measurement of digital ROI.
Reliable performance data that enables informed decisions around digital investments and optimization.
A trusted, standardized single source of truth for digital performance across brands and regions.


Travel Requirements


Must be able to travel up to 10% of the time, including both domestic and international travel.
Typical work-related travel assignments range from 1–3 days and may require overnight, out-of-town stays.
This role operates within a hybrid working arrangement based in Lisbon, Portugal.


Creating Better Together

“Creating better together.” It’s the Enovis purpose, and it’s what drives us and empowers us every day on a global scale.

We know that the power to create better, for our customers, our team members, and our shareholders, begins with having the best team, pursuing common goals, operating at the highest levels, and delivering extraordinary outcomes.

What does creating better together mean to us at Enovis? Discover the “why” behind our purpose, values and behaviors.

Join us in creating better together.

Description:
Country: Portugal

O TEU IMPACTO

O Santander Portugal está à procura de um(a) Analyst de Imparidade e Stress Test (Enterprise Risk Management), para Lisboa - Centro Santander.

Vais integrar uma equipa de Enterprise Risk Management, com forte componente analítica, que apoia decisões estratégicas e o cumprimento de requisitos regulatórios.

Estamos a redefinir a forma como trabalhamos através da inovação, da tecnologia de ponta, da colaboração e da liberdade para explorar novas ideias.

Para ter sucesso nesta função, serás responsável por:


Realizar os cálculos e a análise de imparidade de crédito (IFRS 9) para todas as carteiras do Banco, assegurando qualidade e cumprimento de prazos.
Explorar e analisar bases de dados internas e externas, identificando tendências e produzindo informação de suporte à decisão.
Participar na preparação e execução de exercícios de Stress Test (regulatórios e estratégicos), incluindo ICAAP, EBA e Planeamento Estratégico.
Acompanhar projetos e iniciativas com a Corporação/Grupo, articulando requisitos e assegurando alinhamento metodológico.
Elaborar e manter documentação metodológica e técnica, bem como preparar apresentações e relatórios para diferentes interlocutores.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de processos, automatização e controlo de qualidade de dados e resultados.
Garantir rastreabilidade, governação e evidências para auditoria e conformidade regulatória.


O TEU CONTRIBUTO

As nossas pessoas são a nossa maior força. Cada indivíduo contribui com perspetivas únicas que nos tornam mais fortes como equipa e como organização.

Capacitamos as equipas para irem mais além, valorizando quem são e potenciando o que trazem consigo.

Os seguintes requisitos representam os conhecimentos, competências e capacidades essenciais para o sucesso nesta função. Serão consideradas adaptações razoáveis para permitir que pessoas com deficiência possam desempenhar as funções essenciais.

Experiência Profissional


Experiência em análise quantitativa e tratamento de dados em contexto financeiro e/ou de risco (Obrigatório)
Experiência na exploração de bases de dados e reporting (Excel avançado e/ou SQL/SAS) (Obrigatório)
Experiência de 2-3 anos em cálculo de imparidade (IFRS 9) e/ou Stress Testing (ICAAP/EBA) (Preferencial)


Formação Académica


Formação superior (Licenciatura ou Mestrado) em Matemática, Estatística, Econometria, Gestão de Informação ou área equivalente (Obrigatório)
Formação com forte componente quantitativa e analítica (Obrigatório)
Pós-graduação/Especialização em Risco, Finanças Quantitativas, Data Analytics ou similar (Preferencial)


Idiomas


Português (Obrigatório)
Inglês (Obrigatório)
Espanhol (Preferencial)


Hard Skills


Excel e PowerPoint avançados; experiência na elaboração de reporting e apresentações (Obrigatório)
Bases de dados e manipulação de dados (SQL e/ou SAS Guide) (Obrigatório)
Conhecimentos de IFRS 9 (imparidade), análise macroeconómica e modelos de risco/stress testing (Preferencial)


Soft Skills


Forte capacidade analítica, atenção ao detalhe e pensamento crítico
Organização, planeamento e gestão de prioridades, com orientação a prazos
Comunicação clara, trabalho em equipa e vontade contínua de aprender


Descrição Geral da Função

Integrado(a) na área de Enterprise Risk Management, vais apoiar o Banco na avaliação de imparidade de crédito (IFRS 9) e na execução de exercícios de Stress Test regulatórios e estratégicos. No dia a dia, vais trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados, interagir com diferentes equipas (incluindo a Corporação/Grupo) e produzir documentação e relatórios (reporting) para vários interlocutores. Esta é uma função com elevada exposição a temas de risco, macroeconomia e modelação, com foco em rigor, prazos e melhoria contínua dos processos.

O QUE FAZER A SEGUIR

Se consideras que esta função é do teu interesse, candidata-te.

Title: Commercial Excellence Analyst
Description:
Tem uma forte capacidade analítica, interesse pelo negócio e gosta de transformar dados em decisões comerciais? Gostaria de desempenhar um papel central no suporte às equipas de Vendas e Marketing numa empresa líder de mercado? Então esta oportunidade poderá ser para si.

A Empresa

A Coloplast é uma multinacional dinamarquesa que desenvolve e comercializa dispositivos médicos e produtos de saúde para diversas áreas terapêuticas. A nossa elevada quota de mercado e crescimento sustentado resultam da capacidade de oferecer soluções inovadoras e do elevado nível dos nossos profissionais.

A Posição

Esta é uma posição-chave para o sucesso comercial da subsidiária portuguesa, transformando dados em insights acionáveis e apoiando decisões estratégicas que impulsionam o crescimento do negócio.

A principal missão da função é fornecer informação e análises baseadas em factos para aumentar o desempenho das vendas, a produtividade e a excelência da execução comercial. Será necessária uma excelente capacidade analítica e aptidão para sintetizar grandes volumes de informação, transformando-os em formatos de fácil compreensão para os departamentos de Marketing e Vendas. A função reporta diretamente à Country Manager e integra o planeamento anual e os principais projetos comerciais e estratégicos da organização.

Principais Responsabilidades


Análise de dados: gestão e análise de dados de vendas sell-in e sell-out. Responsável pela relação com a hmR e pela gestão do contrato anual.
Segmentação, Targeting e Compliance: desenvolver e manter modelos de segmentação e definição de clientes prioritários, garantindo a eficiência da estratégia de visitas.
Manutenção do CRM (Salesforce): garantir a qualidade, integridade e completude dos dados, incluindo a área de negócio de consumo.
Pricing e gestão de grossistas: apoiar análises de preços e a gestão de armazenistas e grossistas farmacêuticos.
Suporte analítico à organização: desenvolver análises ad hoc e assegurar a qualidade das ferramentas analíticas e ficheiros Excel.
Apoio à gestão: suportar a equipa de liderança através de análises e recomendações estratégicas.




Perfil Procurado


Mentalidade analítica com forte orientação comercial.
Excelentes competências interpessoais e de comunicação.
Utilizador avançado de Excel; conhecimentos de Power BI serão valorizados.
Experiência com Salesforce ou outro sistema de CRM será considerada uma mais-valia.
Experiência mínima de 2 anos numa função analítica e/ou comercial.
Elevada atenção ao detalhe e rigor analítico.
Capacidade para comunicar conclusões complexas de forma simples e clara.
Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua.
Fluência em português e inglês.




O Que Oferecemos

Integração numa empresa multinacional líder, com formação inicial e contínua, exposição a projetos estratégicos, ambiente internacional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.

Com uma agenda de crescimento ambiciosa, a Coloplast desenvolve e comercializa produtos e serviços que facilitam a vida de pessoas com necessidades íntimas de saúde. Emprega cerca de 16.000 pessoas e com produtos disponíveis em mais de 143 países, somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais em dispositivos médicos. Estamos em constante crescimento e sempre à procura de novas formas de avançar – exploramos, aprendemos e procuramos novas formas de fazer as coisas.

A Coloplast está comprometida em ser uma organização inclusiva, onde as pessoas trazem suas diferenças para o trabalho todos os dias, realizam o seu potencial e têm uma forte sensação de pertença porque – e não apesar – das suas diferenças. Portanto, incentivamos todos os candidatos qualificados a se inscreverem, independentemente do gênero, idade, raça, nacionalidade, etnia, orientação sexual, crença religiosa ou capacidade física.

Title: GCP/Power BI Data Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled professional to join our Squad Data RUN – Data Entreprise, dedicated to ensuring the achievement of business objectives and the effective management of daily operations, including incident resolution and necessary evolutions. This role is pivotal in supporting the transformation of our Data product and requires a strong technical background in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and data transformations tools (ETL/ELT).

Our team focuses on developing and maintaining internal corporate tools utilizing a robust technical stack that includes the BPCE SI cloud ecosystem, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Linux, Python, Power BI, Composer, and SSIS. We employ various methods and tools to enhance our workflow, including Jira and Confluence for project management, Clarity for resource planning, PowerDesigner and DataGalaxy for data modeling, and Dataplex for data management. Our testing processes are supported by Jira Xray, and we adhere to the Agile framework within the BPCE Tempo ecosystem to ensure efficient and adaptive project delivery.

Main Responsibilities


Integrate into the Performance and Run team, collaborating closely with BPCE-SI business units to guarantee the stability of existing systems.
Manage incidents effectively, ensuring minimal impact on operations while implementing necessary system evolutions.
Develop specific components in the context of construction projects, contributing to the overall enhancement of our data capabilities.
Employ Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery and Composer, to optimize data management and analysis.
Utilize Power BI for reporting and visualization, alongside data integration tools such as SSIS to ensure seamless data flow.
Work under the supervision of a squad lead to ensure optimal coordination and successful project execution.
Engage in proactive communication with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical requirements.


Qualifications

Hard Skills:


Proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with a strong understanding of data management and integration practices.
Expertise in Power BI and data integration tools such as SSIS.
Knowledge of programming languages, particularly Python and SQL, for data analysis and manipulation.
Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in daily stand-ups and iterative development practices.
French proficiency is mandatory (B2 level, minimum).


Soft Skills


Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with business units.
Demonstrated ability to understand and prioritize user requirements effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills for effective incident management and minimizing operational impact.
Proactive communication with business stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into technical requirements.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Title: Financial Services Risk & Regulation New Joiners
Description:
At PwC, we focus on creating a promising future, where trust and innovation go hand in hand. Are you ready to take on this challenge with us?

Title: AI Implementation Specialist - Samlino Group
Description:
Are you ready to thrive in a dynamic and exhilarating environment where you'll be entrusted with significant responsibilities? Are you seeking to join an extraordinary team of young, motivated, and highly ambitious individuals? If you have a genuine passion for connecting with people and driving remarkable outcomes, then you could be the perfect fit for our AI Implementation Specialist position.

About us

We are on a mission to help consumers save time and money by matching them with the best products for their needs with banking, insurance and utilities. Samlino Group (https://samlinogroup.com/) operates across three markets, we empowered over 10 million users last year alone, propelling them toward living healthier financial lives.

What we offer you

As our AI Implementation Specialist, you get the unique opportunity to be a key driver of our exponential growth curve. Sunny Lisbon will be your home base, but you'll travel to and work with our three markets! In order to do that you will:


take a front-row seat to the agentic revolution, working with frontier LLMs and advanced autonomous frameworks like OpenClaw to build AI that actually acts
lead the deployment and integration of artificial intelligence solutions
bridge the gap between AI research, software engineering, and product implementation
ensure that AI models and systems are successfully adapted
work closely with our software developers and team leads to design scalable AI workflows
integrate models and ensure performance, reliability, and alignment with our business goals


What we expect from you

We are seeking a dynamic individual who thrives in a results-oriented environment to join our team and help us reach our objectives. Industry experience is not a requirement, but you do need to be highly ambitious, proactive, forward-thinking, a fast learner, and driven to succeed.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:


Have proactive mindset, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
Familiarity with machine learning frameworks
Experience with cloud platforms and containerization tools
Understanding of APIs, RESTful services, and microservice architecture
Fluency in Portuguese and English and an EU work permit is required.


What we offer


Access to Premium AI Infrastructure. Work with an elite toolkit including OpenClaw for local-first agent orchestration and a diverse range of frontier LMs
Collaborative and innovative team environment
Involvement in high-impact projects across industries


Start date and Travel

Flexible start date.

This role will cover all three markets, so regular travel will be part of what we have in mind for you! It will also include extended stays working hands-on with the teams in the different locations.

Title: ESG Data Analyst (VIE)
Description:
Are you ready to shape the future of capital markets? We are looking for an ESG Data Analyst (V.I.E.) to join the ESG Data Team. The position will be based in Lisbon, Portugal, and start since December 2026. You will report to the ESG Data Manager.

You Will Primarily Be Responsible For


Supporting the roll-out of Euronext's supplier engagement plan against its Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) target
Tracking supplier progress on emissions disclosure and target-setting, maintaining the supplier data tracker
Engaging procurement and category managers to embed ESG criteria into supplier onboarding and evaluation
Contributing to the CSRD reporting cycle, including coordination with external auditors
Collecting and calculating carbon footprint data
Supporting EU Taxonomy eligibility and alignment assessments (CapEx, OpEx, turnover KPIs)
Collecting ESG data from business units across Euronext's geographies for public reporting
Maintaining ESG data collection templates and methodology documentation, and identifying new data needs to improve reporting quality and coverage


Your Profile


Degree in finance, sustainability, supply chain or procurement, environmental science, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Familiarity with greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, CSRD or EU Taxonomy reporting
Working knowledge of Excel and comfort handling large, multi-source datasets
Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken
Analytical rigour and attention to detail
Clear communicator, able to work across teams and with external counterparties
Previous experience in sustainable procurement or ESG is a strong plus
Experience with data tools beyond Excel (Power BI, SQL, Python or similar) is a plus
Additional European languages are a plus


Join a Company Where Market Infrastructure Is Built On Innovation — And Where Every Innovation Starts With a Bold Mind Asking, “What’s Next?”. At Euronext, We Believe Change Is a Starting Point, Not An Obstacle. We Look For People Who See Growth Opportunities, Think Long Term And Want To Help Shape Capital Markets For Future Generations. Working With Us Means


Being part of a European, international and diverse team – Collaborate across borders with talented colleagues connected by a shared ambition and purpose.
Learning as you grow – Develop your skills through continuous learning, real responsibilities and flexible career paths that evolve with you.
Having an impact – Contribute to projects that matter, in an agile and dynamic environment where your ideas help drive progress.
Driving sustainability – Play an active role in building transparent, responsible and sustainable capital markets for the long term. Together, we do not just support markets – we help shape their future.


Apply by submitting a CV in English

The ESG Data Team is responsible for Euronext's ESG data and turning it into reliable, reportable information. Its main output is the group's regulatory and public reporting — CSRD, which brings together topics such as EU Taxonomy reporting and carbon footprint accounting, alongside Euronext's other public ESG disclosures. The team also supports delivery of the group's climate targets and drives Euronext's sustainable procurement agenda behind the supplier engagement target. This work is transversal, spanning business units, Procurement, Finance, suppliers and external auditors across the group's geographies and functions.

Join Euronext – Shape capital markets for future generations Euronext is the leading European capital market covering the entire capital markets value chain, from listing, trading, clearing, settlement and custody, to solutions for issuers and investors. We operate eight national stock exchanges, handling 25% of European lit equity trading. Our products include equities, FX, ETFs, bonds, derivatives, commodities and indices. Euronext also provides clearing and settlement services through Euronext Clearing and our network of Euronext Securities CSDs. In addition, Euronext runs MTS, one of Europe’s leading electronic fixed income trading markets, and Nord Pool, the European power market. The company has a diverse domestic and international client base.

Find out more about us at: Euronext.com

Unity


We respect and value the people we work with
We are unified through a common purpose

Accountability

We reward and celebrate performance


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique talents of all our people, who come from diverse backgrounds with different personal experiences and points of view and we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Join Axians, where innovation thrives on trust and autonomy, and where every challenge is an opportunity to create technology with impact.

- Senior Data Scientist

Mobility business unit is evolving how it creates value for its clients, and this role is at the heart of that change. You will be one of the senior people responsible for delivering data and AI solutions to clients. You'll take them from the initial idea, through development and deployment, to measuring and realising their value.

This is more than a data science role. Beyond building models, you will make sure solutions are reliable, coherent and production-ready, so they can be deployed and run with confidence at client sites. Project management stays with the project lead. You will be the technical and methodological reference on the project, and you'll have a real say in how it's delivered.

How you'll get started

You won't be doing this alone. You'll first join a dedicated innovation team, working alongside experienced practitioners who are building similar solutions. You'll be coached while you deliver your first projects, and you'll build the practices and confidence to lead on your own. After that, you'll move fully into the Mobility team as a senior delivery reference.




What We Are Looking For

Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience; certifications in AI/ML or data science are an advantage
3+ years of experience in data science or machine learning roles
Solid knowledge of Python and SQL, and experience with common ML frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Proven experience taking solutions from prototype to production
Experience with, or a strong drive to learn, the engineering side of delivery: cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), MLOps and building reliable platforms
Comfortable working directly with clients and taking ownership of what you deliver
Strong problem-solving mindset and a hands-on approach
Able to communicate complex insights clearly to business audiences and influence decisions
Interest in shaping how solutions and projects are built, not just executing them




What you'll do

Design, build and deploy data and AI solutions that address real client challenges in the Mobility space
Make sure solutions are robust, scalable and ready for production, not just proofs of concept
Contribute to defining project methodology, including scoping, success metrics, delivery phases and best practices for data and ML workflows
Guide the project team on technical and methodological choices and give the project lead input on approach, priorities and risks
Work closely with engineers, analysts, clients and business stakeholders to turn needs into practical solutions
Track and communicate the value your solutions deliver
Share knowledge with the team and help raise the bar on how we work with data and AI




Nice to have

Experience in the mobility, transport or automotive sector
Familiarity with generative AI and LLM-based solutions




What We Offer

- Continuous training

- Flexible work model

- Benefits tailored to the role and experience

Title: Senior Data Scientist – Shiny & Pharma Specialist
Description:
The Shiny lead who turns pharma analytics into actionable apps.




About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics. This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you. Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.




About the role

You will lead the design and delivery of Shiny-based analytics applications for pharma clients, acting as the technical lead on projects and coordinating across developers, data engineers and client stakeholders. You will apply SAGE methodology to structure analytics work, provide senior-level technical support for complex application issues when needed, and ensure outputs map to client needs and commercial value.




Skills and experience




Core Technical Skills

Design, build and optimise Shiny applications that integrate with APIs and demonstrate end-to-end app performance considerations, including data modelling such as star schema.
Produce high-quality, documented SQL and R code with unit tests and reproducible setup, including developing, testing and maintaining reusable R packages for production use, and use containerisation and environment tools such as Docker and Windows Subsystem for Linux to package and distribute solutions.




Interpersonal Traits

Lead customer-facing technical discussions, present project progress and trade-offs to stakeholders, and explain technical risks clearly to non-technical audiences.
Builds strong user relationships by listening carefully to feedback, clarifying needs and communicating progress and outcomes clearly.
Mentor and review colleagues’ work by providing clear, actionable technical feedback and supporting onboarding to develop team capability.
Engage in agile ceremonies and contribute to architectural discussions, driving adoption of good practices and pragmatic technical decisions across the team.




Pharma Experience

Operate in the tech lead role on pharma engagements, coordinating delivery and making decisions that reflect pharma project constraints.
Apply SAGE methodology to structure analytics workstreams and ensure outputs align with client expectations in pharma projects.




Nice to Have

Core Data Science Skills such as; applying statistical rigour and machine learning methods, including designing A/B testing frameworks using frequentist and Bayesian approaches.
Experience using established Shiny development frameworks, such as golem or Rhino, to build structured, maintainable and production-ready applications.
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with the ability to use these technologies to create and enhance interactive visualisations and improve the user experience of Shiny applications.
Experience using the data.table R package to efficiently manipulate, transform and analyse large or complex datasets.




What you will do

Lead delivery of Shiny-based analytics projects for pharma accounts, coordinating cross-functional teams to meet defined success criteria and timelines.
Support user testing by gathering customer feedback on applications, translating it into clear technical requirements, implementing fixes and communicating outcomes back to users.
Advise clients on technical solution design and identify capability or capacity gaps that shape the account approach and opportunity discovery.
Plan and estimate technical delivery work, supporting project management with realistic technical scope, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
Own key deliverables end-to-end, including defining success metrics, performing quality control and presenting outputs that link analytics work to commercial impact.
Contribute to internal assets, proofs-of-concept and accelerators to scale our Shiny and analytics offerings across accounts.
Drive reductions in technical debt by proposing pragmatic trade-offs, prioritising fixes that restore service, and defining repayment plans to improve long-term stability.




Why join us

People are at the Heart of our Business. By investing in people, we achieve exceptional results for our clients and create new opportunities for our teams to thrive.
